			<script>
				var recaptchaLoaded=false;

				$(function() {

					$('.catch-emails .email').bind('keyup',function(e) {
						if(!recaptchaLoaded) {
							$('html').append('<script src="https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render=6Ld_BecUAAAAAAxzQwBa6NY3-m5RDmjVY__ScSww&onload=recaptchaCallback" async defer>'+decodeURI('%3C/script%3E'));
							recaptchaLoaded=true;
						}
						if(!recaptchaLoaded && e.which==13) {
							setTimeout(function() {
								$('.action-subscribe').click();
							},1000);
						}
					});
					$('.action-subscribe').bind('click',function(e) {
						if(!recaptchaLoaded) {
							setTimeout(function() {
								$('.action-subscribe').click();
							},1000);
						}
					});
				});
				
				var recaptchaCallback = function() {
					recaptchaLoaded=true;
					$(function() {
						$('.catch-emails .email').bind('keyup',function(e) {
							if(e.which===13) {
								$('.catch-emails').hide();
								grecaptcha.ready(function() {
								grecaptcha.execute('6Ld_BecUAAAAAAxzQwBa6NY3-m5RDmjVY__ScSww', {action: 'homepage'}).then(function(recaptcha_token) {
										submitSubscribeForm(recaptcha_token);
									});
								});
							}
						});

						$('.action-subscribe').bind('click',function() {
							$('.catch-emails').hide();
							grecaptcha.ready(function() {
							grecaptcha.execute('6Ld_BecUAAAAAAxzQwBa6NY3-m5RDmjVY__ScSww', {action: 'homepage'}).then(function(recaptcha_token) {
								submitSubscribeForm(recaptcha_token);
								});
							});
						});
					});
				};

				function submitSubscribeForm(recaptcha_token) {

					var spamCheckAnswer=prompt("To avoid spam sign ups, please answer: What is 1+1?");
					if(
						spamCheckAnswer!=2 &&
						spamCheckAnswer!='2' &&
						spamCheckAnswer!='two'
					) {
						return;
					}
					
					console.log('submitSubscribeForm');
					$('html').addClass('loading');
					$.ajax({
						url: '/emails/subscribe',
						type:'GET',
						dataType:'json',
						data:{
							format:'json',
							spam_check_answer:spamCheckAnswer,
							FNAME:$('.catch-emails .name').val(),
							EMAIL:$('.catch-emails .email').val(),
							SOURCE:$('.catch-emails .source').val(),
							TAG:$('.catch-emails .tag').val(),
							recaptcha:recaptcha_token
						},
					}).done(function(reply) {
						$('html').removeClass('loading');
						if(reply.success) {
							if(!empty(pageTagTitle)) {
								setCookie('subscribed_to_newsletter_2020fix_'+pageTagTitle, 'true', 365,'/','.remoteok.com');
							}
							else {
								setCookie('subscribed_to_newsletter', 'true', 365,'/','.remoteok.com');
							}
							$('html').removeClass('catch-emails-enabled');
							alert(reply.message);
							// redir after subscribing to newsletter cuz user clicked [ create profile ]
							// "We'll now redirect you so you can sign up to get a remote worker profile and get even more targeted remote job matches."
							window.location.href='/sign-up?email='+encodeURIComponent($('.form .email').val())+'#worker';
						}
						else {
							$('.catch-emails').show();
							if(!empty(reply.message)) {
								alert(reply.message);
							}
							else {
								alert("Something went wrong!\n\nTweet @remoteok if this keeps happening!");
							}
						}
					});
				}
			</script>
		</div>

					<script>

	function windowSize() {
		var e = window, a = 'inner';
		if (!('innerWidth' in window )) {
				a = 'client';
				e = document.documentElement || document.body;
		}
		return { width : e[ a+'Width' ] , height : e[ a+'Height' ] };
	}
	var windowWidth=windowSize().width;
	var windowHeight=windowSize().height;

	$(function() {
		$('.top-bar-dropdown-toggle').bind('click',function() {
			$('.top-left-logo').click();
		});

		$('body').on('dblclick', '.top-left-logo', function(e) {
			window.location.href='/';
		});
		$('.top-left-logo').bind('click',function(e) {
			e.stopPropagation();

			$('.search-filter-results').hide();
			$('.input-salary-filter-container').hide();
			$('.salary-filter-container').removeClass('active');
			$('.input-benefits-filter-container').hide();

			var top=$('.top-left-logo img').offset().top+$('.top-left-logo img').outerHeight()+7;
			var left=0;
			if(left<14) left=14;
			if(left>(windowSize().width-200)) left=(windowSize().width-200);
			if(top<14) top=14;
			if(top>(windowSize().height-200)) var top=(windowSize().height-200);
			$('.top-bar-dropdown').css('left',left+'px');
			$('.top-bar-dropdown').css('top',top+'px');
			$('html').toggleClass('top-bar-dropdown-expanded');
		});
		$('.filter-actions .top-bar-avatar').bind('dblclick',function(e) {
			e.stopPropagation();
			window.location.href='/';
		});

		$('.filter-actions .dropdown-toggle').bind('click',function() {
			$('.filter-actions .top-bar-avatar').click();
		});
		$('.filter-actions .top-bar-avatar').bind('click',function(e) {
			e.stopPropagation();
			$('.search-filter-results').hide();
			$('.input-salary-filter-container').hide();
			$('.salary-filter-container').removeClass('active');
			$('.input-benefits-filter-container').hide();

			$('.top-bar-dropdown').css('position','absolute');
			$('.top-bar-dropdown').css('left',$(this).offset().left);
			$('.top-bar-dropdown').css('top',$(this).offset().top+$(this).height()+7);
			$('html').toggleClass('top-bar-dropdown-expanded');
		});
	});
</script>

This 100% remote position is for self-starters with good communication skills, work ethic, and the ability to participate in all aspects of the agile software development life cycle.\nHighlights &amp; Benefits of working at Emergent Software\n\n* Work closely with other talented engineers and team members. We invest in your growth!\n* Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful\n* Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave\n\n\nTypical Tech Stack\n\n* C# and .NET (latest versions)\n* Blazor or React (JS or TypeScript)\n* Azure SQL\n* Azure PaaS (App Services, Blob Storage, Service Bus, etc.)\n* Azure DevOps for CI/CD\n* Umbraco, Sitecore, or Contentful (when CMS is required)\n\n\nPrimary Duties\n\n* Solve client needs by building new custom software, enhancements, bug fixes, or consulting.\n* Work on a full scrum team contributing new code and reviewing pull requests on a large enterprise scale software project.\n* Or lead mid-sized software development projects from start to finish balancing work from multiple projects simultaneously.\n* Participate in technical requirements gathering, technology selection, data modeling, Azure infrastructure design, and DevOps &amp; CI/CD process design with guidance from other technical and architecture experts.\n* Architect &amp; develop new applications and features using industry standard best practices.\n* Meet with clients to craft technology solutions that meet their business needs and estimate the effort required to deliver.\n* Collaborate with other software developers on an agile development team.\n* Provide code feedback to other developers through pull request reviews.\n* Share your knowledge at regular talk shop and lunch &amp; learn sessions to help build a stronger team.\n* Other related duties as assigned by your manager.\n\n\nRequired Qualifications\n\n* Advanced experience with Microsoft stack web development (C#, .NET, SQL Server, Azure, JavaScript, HTML, CSS)\n* Competence in at least four areas in the full stack with advanced experience in at least one:\n1. 									<div class="html"><p><em>This opportunity is open to individuals seeking full-time employment or individuals seeking contract opportunities.</em></p><h2>About Headway</h2><p>Founded in 2015, <a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://headway.io/careers">Headway</a> was born out of a passion to bring entrepreneurial ideas to market and keep them there. We work holistically with our client partners as a true extension of their product team, not just as an execution arm of their business. If we see something broken, whether that's a workflow, a marketing or messaging strategy, or a needless feature, we speak up, and our clients trust us to help them fix it.</p><p>Because we're more than just designers, developers, and product strategists, we achieve results that bring successful long-term partnerships and trusted referrals. We help entrepreneurs and corporate innovators&nbsp;<em>build a business</em> ― not just an app. Our approach to validating ideas and building sustainable business models has been a catalyst for our growth. This approach, coupled with realistic and incremental software releases, results in a friendly, fun, and collaborative atmosphere where our colleagues and clients both have room to learn and grow.</p><p>View our&nbsp;<a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.headway.io/work">case studies</a> and see how our clients talk about <a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="http://headway.io/compass/">our approach</a>.</p><p>We're actively engaged with our community through various <a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.headway.io/events">live streams and videos</a> to help startups and product teams reach their goals. We're excited about what we've achieved in the last 10 years, but we're just getting started. We need your help to take us to the next level!</p><h2>A Day In The Life</h2><p>During a typical work week, our crew members enjoy a balanced assignment of 35 hours on client projects with the ability to invest the other 5 hours in a combination of individual goals and team meetings.</p><h2>What Does Success Look Like?</h2><p>During your first 2-4 weeks at Headway, you'll have an opportunity to meet with lots of crew members across the company and start to understand our unique approach to product development. This includes several "Headway 101" sessions that cover everything from our project management style, to our design aesthetic and business analysis approach, to development tools and techniques.</p><p>After this initial period, you'll be successfully contributing to new feature work on a client project in the context of a team. You'll also be participating in daily standups, sprint planning meetings, and retrospectives. <em>Welcome aboard!</em></p><h2>Ongoing Support</h2><p>Each week, you'll meet with your team lead to ensure that you have the time and attention you need to be successful. Your needs and questions will always come first in this meeting, but other topics discussed include:</p><ul><li>Individual quarterly goal progress</li><li>Project status / team issues / weekly retro</li><li>Individual responses to our health questionnaire</li></ul><h2>Quarterly and Annual Reviews</h2><p>In addition to weekly touchpoint meetings, more formal quarterly reviews are scheduled to discuss successes and areas for growth identified over the last 3 months. We have annual performance assessments and salary reviews, though we reserve the right to provide a merit-based pay raise at any time. Most crew members achieve a 5% raise each year within their same role, but bigger jumps are possible when roles or responsibilities increase. We're here to grow with you sustainably over the long term.</p><h2>Experience and Results At Every Level</h2><p>With an experienced leadership team encompassing design, development, sales, marketing, product, and operations, Headway is poised for an amazing 2025. Our business has&nbsp;strong processes, documentation, and people to support your growth and development. As they say, “Train people well enough so they can leave, treat them well enough so they don't want to.” For more on that, check out our benefits below!</p><h2>Why Should You Apply?</h2><ul><li>Work on exciting <a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.headway.io/case-studies">projects</a> in the latest tech across a variety of industries including the following:<ul><li>Healthcare and Fitness</li><li>Financial Technology</li><li>Logistics and Supply Chain</li><li>Social and Communication</li></ul></li><li>Collaborate with colleagues and clients directly to ship features that users love.</li><li>Work with appreciative clients who seek out and value your input and feedback.</li><li>Strong leadership and top-notch colleagues to help you realize your full potential.</li><li>Career growth and leadership opportunities.</li></ul><h2>Key Benefits</h2><ul><li>3 weeks of PTO &amp; Sick Time are available immediately.</li><li>4 weeks of paid parental leave.</li><li>1 week of additional time off during the winter holiday season.</li><li>100% of health care and dental premiums paid for you and all your dependents.</li><li>Up to a 4% matching 401k contribution based on your dollar contribution.</li><li>Generous hardware onboarding budget including a self-directed budget to purchase the gear you need to be successful.</li><li>An annual education and conference budget.</li></ul><h2>Position Description</h2><p>As a Senior Developer at Headway, you are client and user-focused while executing on the details of each project. You diligently develop features and functionality, guided by Headway's process to ensure each release is successful. This role requires constant learning and a growth mindset.</p><p>When communicating with clients during sprint planning, retros, and release demos, you help monitor features as project requirements change, and direct emergent requirement discussions back to the core focus of a minimum viable product (MVP). In doing so, you help manage client expectations and project scope, ensuring we build the most valuable features first.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><p>As a Senior Developer at Headway, you are responsible for executing within the Headway development process with a focus on client and user needs including:</p><ul><li>Setting the project development direction consistent with Headway technology and standards.</li><li>Creating architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and ER diagrams to increase the team's understanding of project scope and support the overall development process.</li><li>Helping to enforce development process and consistency across the team.</li><li>Performing development critiques and QA on pull requests ensuring Headway development process is followed.</li><li>Suggesting refactoring that will help curb technical debt and grow knowledge across the team.</li><li>Conducting pairing sessions to help developers learn and grow while also evaluating their craft, including: efficiency, adherence to process, and overall professionalism.</li><li>Performing QA of both internal code quality, interfaces, architecture, tests, and external end-user UI/UX.</li><li>Interfacing with clients during sprint planning sessions and retros to ensure projects are on track and on budget.</li><li>Driving all meetings and development activities from the outside-in with user story mapping and MoSCoW prioritization.</li><li>Helping assess potential hires for technical ability and team fit for future positions at Headway.</li></ul><p><em>Help us make a difference, make waves, and make Headway!</em></p><h2>Requirements</h2><ul><li>3+ year of paid, professional mobile development experience (required).</li><li>5+ years of paid, professional general development experience (required), with consulting experience a plus.</li><li>Experience in React Native. (required)</li><li>Experience with or willingness to learn native iOS and Android.</li><li>Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).</li><li>The ability to present your work and stand firm for the right reasons.</li><li>Experience working with businesses at various phases of creation and growth.</li><li>Experience with full-stack technologies like Ruby on Rails, Phoenix/Elixir, or Node, a big plus.</li></ul><h2>Expectations</h2><ul><li>You live by our <a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="http://headway.io/about">Guiding Manifesto</a> and embody the core values of Headway.</li><li>You are open to criticism from your team and are always eager to learn and to share knowledge.</li><li>You have the ability to think big while being detail-oriented and delivery-focused.</li><li>You are self-motivated and able to deal with pressure and work well in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>You have an outgoing, personable, and sociable attitude.</li><li>You have the initiative to solve challenges, meet goals, and set new directions based on data.</li><li>You are capable of inspiring colleagues and clients.</li><li>You have a passion to create useful and valuable solutions.</li><li>You prioritize and attend our team weeks in Wisconsin, or at an awesome TBD destination.</li></ul><h2>The Hiring Process</h2><p>If after we review your application and we choose to move forward, the following interviews will typically take place over the course of 1-3 weeks (depending on scheduling):</p><ul><li>Work history and aspirations chat with our People and Team Strategist (30 min).</li><li>Skills and performance discussion with a Development Lead (30 min).</li><li>Take-home skills assessment with the potential for follow-up/discussion/remote pairing at this stage (3-4 hours).</li><li>Group interview with several members of the Headway team (45 min).</li><li>EQi and Kolbe assessment exercise (1-2 hours).</li></ul><h2>Next Steps</h2><p>If this sounds like you, we’d love to have you apply! We're a remote-first company so this position is open to developers local to the Green Bay, WI area, and anyone living in and able to work in the US.</p>																																				Please mention the word <strong>NOBLE</strong> when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTU0LjE4MC4xNTkuMTM3). Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, use our material into their curricula. Help us&nbsp;<strong>take online education to new heights</strong>&nbsp;and make a&nbsp;<strong>meaningful impact on humankind</strong>. We’re entering our third decade with over 170,000 graduates.&nbsp;</p><p><strong>We’re proud to have assembled a remarkable team of unicorns</strong>&nbsp;who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?</p><p>Project Overview</p><p><strong>Our flagship product</strong>&nbsp;is a&nbsp;<strong>vast platform</strong>&nbsp;with over 30 sub-domains for online courses, masterclasses, online forums, and community meet-ups in 508 cities in 107 countries. We understand what PHP developers need to thrive, and we've created an environment that delivers.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><ul><li><p><strong>Close to Legacy-Free Codebase.</strong>&nbsp;We know how technical debt and legacy code can turn into quicksand, so we continually eradicate it. Some examples include&nbsp;<strong>the complete rewrite of our notification and payment system&nbsp;</strong>and numerous enhancements made to our course platform<strong>.</strong>&nbsp;</p></li><li><p><strong>Consistent Coding Standards.</strong>&nbsp;We are proud of our strict coding standards, which is the cornerstone of our clean and maintainable codebase. You can find numerous examples in the&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/">IxDF Handbook</a></strong>, which includes our conventions for&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/library/backend/conventions--php.html">PHP</a></strong>,&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/library/backend/conventions--laravel.html">Laravel</a></strong>,&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/library/backend/conventions--sql.html">SQL</a></strong>,&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/library/frontend/conventions--js.html">JavaScript</a></strong>, and&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/library/frontend/conventions--css.html">CSS</a></strong>, along with other&nbsp;<strong><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://handbook.interaction-design.org/library/backend/literature.html">useful resources</a></strong>. Any line of code should be a succinct, well-crafted, and self-explanatory piece of communication to your future self or your colleague. To string things together, we mix in just the right amount of documentation, with best practices such as focusing on the “why?” and keeping it simple.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></li><li><p><strong>Focus on what matters</strong>: Our CI/CD pipeline uses quality tools such as Psalm, PHPStan, Rector, PHPCS, PHP CS Fixer, Deptrac, and ESLint to ensure consistency and code quality. This means we’re almost bug-free despite having numerous, zero-downtime, fully automated deployments to production every day. We don’t like bugs and would rather focus on what matters most.&nbsp;</p></li><li><p><strong>Test Coverage</strong>: “The only way to go fast, is to go well - Robert C. Martin”. We love automated testing, especially Unit Tests, and use TDD as much as we can. We've been increasing our test coverage over the years, reaching an overall 38% test coverage throughout the system, with critical systems having over 80% test coverage.</p></li></ul><p>The Stack You Will Work On</p><p>#UseThePlatform. 									<div class="html"><div class="sc-1fwbcuw-0 hBnGNj"><div><p>We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (Python) to improve and expand our Open Source and Cloud Products. You will work with the Senior Product people, including the CTO and an experienced team of Data, Backend, Frontend, and full-stack engineers. You will own the implementation of major features in Soda Core and Soda Cloud for our Data Observability and Data Testing offerings. You will share your Data Engineering expertise with the rest of the engineering team.</p><p>As we grow, we expect you to grow with us. As our company scales, we envision a successful candidate to develop into an Engineering Lead or a similar position.</p><h2>About Soda</h2><p>Soda helps customers detect, resolve, and prevent data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. We enable Data Engineers to effectively own DQ by “shifting left” the data quality initiatives from business to engineering.&nbsp;</p><p>Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten, an employee #5 in Collibra, where he worked in Go-To-Market leadership, and Tom, who launched multiple OSS projects that generated 100s Million in value. Together, they built a tool that ensures data quality across Data Engineering, Data Governance, and business use cases.&nbsp;</p><p>Soda’s product offering consists of an open-source project called Soda Core, which is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. Soda commercializes its software through the Soda Cloud product. We're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.&nbsp;</p><p>This is a unique opportunity to shape the Data Quality software used by Data Engineers for the decades to come.</p><h2>Benefits</h2><ul><li><p>The opportunity to be a part of the exciting early stages of a well-funded, European-based Open Source start-up with significant traction and massive venture potential</p></li><li><p>Fully Remote Working Environment with an option to work from an office</p></li><li><p>Compensation: up to 110 000 EUR/year + equity</p></li></ul><h2>Our Values</h2><p>We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We dislike politics and bullshit and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical and overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions and prioritize and organize your work how you see fit.</p><p>❤&nbsp;<strong><em>Why you will love to join Soda</em></strong></p><ul><li><p>Working with a fast-growing international VC-funded startup with a flat structure</p></li><li><p>You will have full ownership of the things you work on</p></li><li><p>An international and diverse team</p></li><li><p>Fully remote, flexible work, with as many opportunities to meet up as you want!</p></li><li><p>Open Source Product with all the perks that come with that</p></li></ul><p>😡&nbsp;<strong><em>What you might not love</em></strong></p><ul><li><p>Fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done</p></li><li><p>You will have to learn new things all the time</p></li></ul></div></div><div class="sc-1fwbcuw-0 hBnGNj"><div><h2>Responsibilities</h2><ul><li><p>Shape the product direction by collaborating with users, customers, and the team to implement new Soda Cloud and Soda Core features that solve real-world data engineering problems.</p></li><li><p>Work on scaling Soda Cloud for a billion datasets.</p></li><li><p>Directly contribute to our open-source library by designing, implementing, and maintaining new Observability and Data Testing features.</p></li><li><p>Implement internal tooling to facilitate product development</p></li></ul><h2>Requirements</h2><ul><li><p><strong>Experience building data/ML products or cloud-based software</strong></p></li><li><p>Deep knowledge of software engineering best practices like SOLID and design patterns</p></li><li><p>Strong experience with Python Data Stack and SQL skills</p></li><li><p>Deep understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, pipeline testing, data mesh, and related data engineering concepts.</p></li><li><p>Exceptional communication skills in English - both oral and written.</p></li><li><p>You are a swift learner and can easily pick up new concepts.</p></li><li><p>You are incredibly proactive, independent, and comfortable in proposing new ideas. 																			<div style="text-align:left;font-size:32px;">
											<span style="font-weight: 400;">Buoy Software is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Security &amp; Risk Engineer US based</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nAbout Buoy Software\n\n\nOur mission is to deliver the best experience possible to as many donors of blood products (such as plasma) as possible, in as many communities as possible. We use our understanding of blood product donation and the industry’s regulations and pair them with our extensive consumer product experience to enrich the lives of our members and improve health outcomes for patients everywhere.&nbsp;\n\n\nIn an industry that hasn’t seen innovation in more than two decades, Buoy’s software streamlines the donation process allowing our business to promote loyalty while improving efficiency in a donation center. In turn, the increase in blood product donations improves a supply level that is at an all time low, and allows for blood-product derived biotherapies to continue to evolve, improve, and save lives for those who face life-threatening conditions (i.e. immune deficiencies and blood disorders). Without an increase in blood product donations, we are facing a worldwide health crisis that ultimately results in rationing of care without the proper resources. Buoy Software is excited to be playing more of a role in improving the state of blood products and blood product donations.\n\n\nWe’re working alongside Join Parachute ([www.joinparachute.com/](http://www.joinparachute.com/)) in the opening of small market donation centers across the country that will create local donation center careers, opportunities to donate blood products, and provide financial compensation for those donations that will have a positive economic impact in those communities.&nbsp;\n\n\nThe need for blood products is growing rapidly. We want to close the gap in blood product supply and demand by empowering organizations with the right tools. Buoy is the intuitive, data-driven mobile application for donors.\n\n\nAbout The Role\n\n\nWe're looking for a Security and Risk Engineer to join our team. You should be someone who is comfortable and experienced in risk management and code review. This role will work closely with specific product engineering pods, owning all security controls and documentation for assigned pods. You should have an eye for continuous improvement, risk and vulnerability management, and security compliance.\n\n\n\nWhat you’ll do:\n* Oversee vulnerability and security risk management including, but not limited to, vulnerability and risk identification/assessment, crafting mitigation proposals, tracking mitigation status, and testing and validating mitigation methods\n* Oversee security compliance activities including, but not limited to, hazard analyses, threat modeling, root cause analysis, and creating, updating, and maintaining policies and other relevant documentation\n* Manage continuous monitoring and auditing processes to detect and respond to security incidents\n* Perform code assessments to determine any impacts for Buoy’s applications\n* Responsible for defining, implementing, evaluating, and maintaining the effectiveness of security and risk controls\n* Identify current and emerging issues including security trends, vulnerabilities, and threats\n* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders on projects and audits\n* Design security controls that increase operational efficiency and reduces the likelihood of control failure\n* Perform third party security assessments\n* Educate and train staff on security best practices\n\n\n\nWho you are: \n* You have experience with threat modeling analysis such as STRIDE and Attack Tree methodologies.\n* You have experience with software as a service.\n* You are a self starter. You enjoy working in an environment where you have a lot of autonomy. You are not one to wait around to be given work, but are always looking for ways in which you can provide support for your colleagues.\n* You can adapt to change quickly and thrive in an environment where every day is different / you own a variety of tasks.\n* You are a team player. Everyone contributes within the Buoy team, and you want to help the team get the job done when needed, regardless of initial ownership.\n* You are professional in your collaboration and communication methods. You can represent Buoy and our values both internally and externally (with vendors / partners) as needed.\n\n\n\nIn the first 30 days, you will…\n* Be introduced to the team - we’ll help you start to get to know your colleagues, point of contacts for various scenarios, understanding dynamics within the broader org.\n* Learn how Buoy Software operates internally - we’ll help you get accustomed to Buoy’s process, engineering terminology, and other cultural aspects of working here.\n* Go through product demos to start to understand Buoy Software and how it works for both donors experience and donor processing.\n* Begin meeting with and getting to know your direct manager who will share various projects and goals for this role to provide guidance as you settle into the position.\n* Review existing security documentation and determine gaps or improvements.\n* Hit the ground running!\n\n\n\nIn the first 60 days, you will…\n* Understand goals for your respective pods over the next 6 - 12 months.\n* Begin implementing solutions for gaps identified and performing all duties related to continuous management of security for your pods.\n* Become more familiar with workflows and processes.\n* Become more autonomous as you work with your pods and other stakeholders.\n* Start to define timelines for various projects with your manager to help prioritize your focus and align them with the goals for this role.\n* Begin to suggest changes and improvements to the security program and/or internal processes.\n\n\n\nIn the first 90 days, you will…\n* Meet with stakeholders across the broader Buoy Software organization.\n* Become more familiar with the other departments across Buoy Software (including leadership, support, customer success, marketing, and people ops).\n\n\n\n\n\n$120,000 - $140,000 a year\n\nWhere you'll be\nWe are fully remote. We deeply believe in distributed teams at Buoy. We build projects around motivated individuals. We give our team the environment, support and trust they need to get the job done. \n\n\nWe are only considering candidates currently based in the United States at this time. \n\n\n---\nEmployment at Buoy Software is contingent upon achievement of satisfactory results on your background check and reference check and your ability to provide proof of your identity and eligibility to accept employment in the United States.																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

You’re a full-stack engineer who can set up a database, build beautiful interactions and enjoy building complex things. You’ll get to work alongside the CTO (<a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/victorkmita/">Victor Kmita</a>) and tech lead (Arpit Dubey), who will help you navigate the technical complexities of what you’re building.</p><p dir="ltr"><strong>Programming Languages</strong></p><p dir="ltr">We’re looking for software engineers who are proficient in the following technologies:</p><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Typescript / React</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Node.js</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">GraphQL</p></li></ul><p dir="ltr"><strong>Requirements</strong></p><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">5+ years of experience developing React and Node.js applications</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Advanced level of Javascript</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">A good sense of UX patterns</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Experience building and shipping production ready code</p></li></ul><p dir="ltr"><strong>Location</strong></p><p dir="ltr">India, Remote</p><p dir="ltr"><strong>Relationship</strong></p><p dir="ltr">We prefer contract-to-hire relationships so we can both get to know each other, but we’re also open to full-time employment for the right candidate.</p><p dir="ltr"><strong>How we work</strong></p><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Distributed teamwork wherever you want.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Most of our customers are based in North America. You’ll be expected to be available during the time of 8am - 10am PT for meetings, conversations, etc.. Most of our hiring will be focused in the Americas and Europe time zones.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Asynchronous communication is the default - Linear for issues, Slack for conversations, Figma for design, Email for formal/external messages, Zoom for video, Github for eng.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">We meet weekly to check-in, but mainly work independently throughout the week. Each team member is responsible for getting feedback on their projects from the broader group.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Default to no meeting. We want free time for focused work. We have 2 internal meetings across the company every week.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">We’re a hyper growth startup. This will not be the easiest job you’ll ever have, but our goal is to make it the most rewarding. We hope you will learn a lot and make some money along the way.</p></li></ul><p><strong><br></strong></p><p dir="ltr"><strong>About Dock</strong></p><p dir="ltr"><strong>What we’re building</strong></p><p dir="ltr">Dock is a collaborative workspace for prospects and customers. With Dock, companies manage the entire customer journey from sales to success. Dock workspaces combine project plans and embedded multimedia content in a single workspace for customers. Sales teams use Dock to share sales content, enable buyer champions and manage the sales process. Customer</p><p dir="ltr">Success teams use Dock to onboard customers and manage ongoing relationships. Agencies and service firms use Dock to create client portals. Over time, we’re adding more features to help revenue teams collaborate with customers and each other.&nbsp;</p><p dir="ltr">To learn more about Dock, we recommend reading and watching the following resources:</p><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr"><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.dock.us/library/seed-round">Seed round blog post</a></p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr"><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/04/dock-helps-sales-teams-build-share-and-recycle-sales-collateral-microsites/">Techcrunch article</a></p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr"><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.forbes.com/sites/kevinkruse/2022/06/23/how-alex-kracov-built-dock-the-b2b-tool-that-keeps-decision-makers-from-drowning-in-information/?sh=3f4b58f8678b">Forbes article</a></p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr"><a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cb6hDGPrUdg">Video explainer</a></p></li></ul><p><strong><br></strong></p><p dir="ltr">Dock is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. 										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">Who are we and what do we do? BrowserStack is the world's leading software testing platform powering over two million tests every day across 19 global data centers. BrowserStack's products help developers build bug-free software for the 5 billion internet users accessing websites and mobile applications through millions of combinations of digital environments—devices, browsers, operating systems, and versions. We help Tesco, Shell, NVIDIA, Discovery, Wells Fargo, and over 50,000 customers deliver quality software at speed by moving testing to our Cloud. With BrowserStack, Dev and QA teams can move fast while delivering an amazing experience for every customer. BrowserStack was founded by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal in 2011 with the vision of becoming the testing infrastructure for the internet. We recently secured $200 million in Series B funding at a $4 billion valuation in June 2021. At BrowserStack we solve real problems—each day is a unique challenge and an opportunity to make a difference. We strive to be open, transparent, and collaborative, so no feat is too big to achieve. BrowserStack is an extension of its people and a place where they can grow both professionally and personally. To that effect, we’re humbled to be recognized by leading organizations around the world: BrowserStack is Great Place to Work-Certified™ 2020-21 Named “SaaS Startup of the Year” in 2022 by SaaSBOOMi Ranked in Forbes Cloud 100 in 2021 - for the second time Featured in LinkedIn Top Startups India 2018 Role in nutshell: You will design, develop, document, and support systems and applications that are used by a large number of developers. You will work in an agile engineering team and will plan and execute technical projects that will support business requirements. You will collaborate with engineers across teams to build, review and deliver scalable solutions for different use-cases Desired experience: Software development or programming experience of 1 - 3 years of experience. Extensive experience with at least one language: Ruby, Nodejs, Python, Java, C/C++. Good knowledge of operating systems, databases and networking concepts Ability to work on Windows and Linux platforms below the application layer, including file systems, kernels, custom installations, scripting, internal APIs, etc Ability to communicate effectively with employees in the company in both technical and non-technical roles Aggressive problem diagnosis and solving real-world problems effectively. Should have a startup mentality, high willingness to learn, and be hardworking and be able to work in a fast-paced environment. What will you do? You will design and develop systems and applications, with agility and quality at scale. You will take responsibility for end-to-end ownership of tasks from development to production. Also will help with the design, implementation, and launch of many key product features. Participate in a culture of code reviews and collaborating closely with other engineers Drive best practices and engineering improvements Find solutions and solve issues around a variety of operating systems or programming languages Benefits: In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy: Medical insurance for self, spouse, upto 2 dependent children and Parents or Parents-in-law up to INR 5,00,000 Gratuity as per payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 Unlimited Time Off to ensure our people invest in their wellbeing, to rest and rejuvenate, spend quality time with family and friends Remote-First work environment that allows our people to work from anywhere in India Remote-First Benefit for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience At BrowserStack we’re building the testing infrastructure for the world. We’re extremely curious, passionate, and customer-obsessed about our mission of empowering developers to build amazing experiences. We know we’ll grow only when our people grow—so we build teams that are open, transparent, collaborative, and above all supportive. We’re remote-first and our people have the choice to work from anywhere—it’s our core values that bring us all together and drive everything we do. We’re thinkers, movers, innovators, and doers who believe no feat is too big to achieve. We strive to deliver awesome results, fast; and in that way, we’re a lot like you.																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

									<div class="markdown">\nAbout Recast:&nbsp;\nRecast Software, located in Minneapolis, MN, empowers organizations to better manage and support users and devices. Our mission is to simplify the work of IT teams and enable them to create highly secure and compliant environments. Our software does this by seamlessly integrating with existing IT infrastructure to quickly remediate issues, ensure compliance, enhance security, and maintain clear visibility across all devices. Recast is a rapidly growing software company with its solution being used by thousands of enterprise organizations in more than 125 countries, impacting millions of devices and (more importantly) the people who use them.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n\n\nRecast Software has a blend of multi-tenant SaaS and on-premises applications. We have grown rapidly and have a variety of large enterprise global customers using our software. We are just starting our architectural planning to bring our applications together into one platform that will be a hybrid multi-tenant cloud and single-tenant on-premises application. We provide critical system software that companies use to manage their endpoints – from individual laptops to systems used in 24/7 manufacturing environments. Our solutions ensure that endpoints are secure and compliant, which reduces end-user issues and improves reliability.&nbsp;\n\n\nRecast Software’s headquarters are in Minneapolis, MN with offices in Rotterdam, Netherlands and Jyväskylä, Finland. Recast is a remote-first company.&nbsp;\n\n\nAbout the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;\nRecast Software is hiring a Principal Software Engineer to join our growing team! This is a new position in our engineering org that will work across United States and European scrum teams. You’ll be a technical expert and resource for our software engineers. In this role, you’ll use your technical expertise in .Net and experience building distributed, enterprise SaaS applications to help us deliver our next generation of products. In addition to coding, you’ll play a key role in partnering with architecture and designing products.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n\n\n\nLeadership Responsibilities: \n* Collaborate with other senior technical leaders to update and execute on the architectural roadmap to enable Recast’s growth.&nbsp;\n* Work with others to determine the appropriate tradeoff between time to market and technical advancement.&nbsp;\n* With others, choose and pilot new technologies to improve team effectiveness.&nbsp;\n* Lead code reviews and participate/lead in software design reviews.&nbsp;\n* Mentor and train software engineers.&nbsp;\n* Strong proponent of engineering best practices.&nbsp;\n\n\n\n   Technical Responsibilities: \n* Lead the team from an on-premises solution to a hybrid cloud on-premises multitenant architecture.&nbsp;\n* Design multi-tenant applications that run in a hybrid cloud on-premises environment.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* Active member of a product scrum team responsible for application code, test code, and overall effectiveness of software.&nbsp;\n* Support the entire SDLC – from listening to customers, to designing, developing, and maintaining applications, to assisting support and managing the production environment.&nbsp;\n\n\n\nMinimum Requirements: \n* Expertise with distributed B2B SaaS systems.&nbsp;\n* Expertise in C#, .NET Core and the Microsoft stack, and React. Additional technologies preferred.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* Expertise throughout the stack: back-end, front-end, persistence.&nbsp;\n* Actively involved in or have led system redesign.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* Possess both technical breadth and depth.&nbsp;\n\n\n\nPreferred Knowledge and Skills: \n* Expertise is front end development and JavaScript libraries and frameworks.&nbsp;\n* Strong experience with WPF.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* Experience with systems administration (Windows), or sincere interest in solving infrastructure/ systems level problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* Experience designing highly scalable SaaS solutions.&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* Strong fundamental understanding of building cloud-based solutions (Azure).&nbsp;&nbsp;\n\n\n\n\n\n\nWhat you bring:&nbsp;\n• You take initiative. We have a culture of ownership and progress over perfection. We proactively drive outcomes with self-motivation and determination. We deliver results that matter for our customers and our team.\n• You get curious. Curiosity moves us forward. We ask questions, try new things, and learn from mistakes. Challenges are opportunities to explore creative solutions that benefit our customers and drive continuous improvement.\n• You work together. We appreciate the power of diverse perspectives. 									<div class="markdown">\nAbout Recast:\nRecast Software, located in Minneapolis, MN, empowers organizations to better manage and support users and devices. Our mission is to simplify the work of IT teams and enable them to create highly secure and compliant environments. Our software does this by seamlessly integrating with existing IT infrastructure to quickly remediate issues, ensure compliance, enhance security, and maintain clear visibility across all devices. Recast is a rapidly growing software company with its solution being used by thousands of enterprise organizations in more than 125 countries, impacting millions of devices and (more importantly) the people who use them.&nbsp;\n\n\nAbout the Role: \nWe’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Marketing Manager to support Recast Software’s accelerated growth by leading go-to-market strategies&nbsp; for multiple products in the IT security space. You will analyze the target markets, identify customer needs and use cases, develop positioning and compelling content, and enable the sales organization to&nbsp; move pipeline forward effectively.&nbsp; This is a high-visibility role exercising critical thinking to help connect the dots between Product, Marketing, and Sales teams with key insights.\n\n\n\nWhat You’ll Do: \n* Be a proactive project leader. Build relationships with internal stakeholders and identify new opportunities that drive impact and cross-functional alignment. Create go-to-market strategies that ensure organizational readiness across teams with unified positioning and efficient execution.&nbsp;\n* Be an advisor for the Marketing team. Leverage product, sales, customer, and market data to guide marketing strategy, refine personas and ICP, create messaging frameworks, and drive buyer interest with meaningful content through the full funnel.&nbsp;\n* Be a catalyst for the Sales team. Tie product capabilities to tangible proof points and ROI. Enable sales teams with internal training, core assets, win/loss analysis, and competitive differentiators to streamline the buyer journey and accelerate pipeline.&nbsp;\n* Be a partner for the Product team. Support product releases and roadmap prioritization with market analysis, customer use cases, and product feedback, with an aptitude to translate technical specs into business outcomes.&nbsp;\n* Be the voice of the customer. Study customer needs and advocate on their behalf to continually refine our product offerings and GTM efforts with the customer at the forefront. Conduct user interviews to surface pain points and socialize best practices through case studies and testimonials.&nbsp;\n* Be an expert on the market. Keep close tabs on competitive players, industry trends, buyer personas, pricing models, and evolving technology, feeding actionable insights back to stakeholders. Identify new business cases and advise as a subject matter expert.\n\n\n\nMinimum Requirements: \n* 5+ years of B2B software product marketing experience&nbsp;\n* Cross-functional influence with the ability to spearhead projects and mobilize teams to execute a shared vision&nbsp;\n* A track record of leading successful GTM launches including the creation of market analysis, use cases, product positioning, core assets, sales enablement, and training\n* Experience working directly with Product teams with knowledge of the software development lifecycle to help support releases and product evolution&nbsp;\n* Experience working directly with Sales teams with knowledge of enterprise buying motions to help streamline the sales cycle and close deals&nbsp;\n* Proficiency in storytelling with compelling presentation and writing skills&nbsp;\n* Flexibility working both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and evolving environment&nbsp;&nbsp;\n* A solution-mindset with natural tendency spot opportunities and problem solve&nbsp;\n\n\n\nPreferred Knowledge and Skills:\n* Familiarity with IT infrastructure and on-prem, co-managed, and cloud deployment models\n* Experience marketing to technical buying committees within the IT/Security space\n\n\n\n\n\n\nWhat you bring:&nbsp;\n• You take initiative. We have a culture of ownership and progress over perfection. We proactively drive outcomes with self-motivation and determination. We deliver results that matter for our customers and our team.\n• You get curious. Curiosity moves us forward. We ask questions, try new things, and learn from mistakes. Challenges are opportunities to explore creative solutions that benefit our customers and drive continuous improvement.\n• You work together. We appreciate the power of diverse perspectives. Through open communication, we help one another and leverage our collective expertise for better outcomes. We build trust through teamwork.\n• You embrace change. Change is inevitable; we meet it with agility and resilience. We navigate with courage and find possibility in uncertainty. We adapt for the future, shaping our path with purpose.&nbsp;\n• You choose empathy. We aim to deeply understand the needs of our customers and one another - it's the foundation of our relationships. We assume positive intent and practice mutual respect. We prioritize a culture of belonging because success is a shared journey.\n&nbsp;\nCompensation, Benefits, &amp; Perks:&nbsp;\n• The salary range for this position is $120,000-$150,000. Additionally, cash compensation for this role includes 10% annual discretionary bonus potential. Salary may vary based on experience, skills, and geographical location.&nbsp;\n• Medical, dental, and vision\n• FSA or HSA with company contributions&nbsp;\n• Employer paid STD, LTD, AD&amp;D and life insurance&nbsp;\n• 401k with 4% employer match\n• Work-life balance, flexible time off, and remote work options\n• Parental leave\n\n\nWhy do we love working at Recast?\nIt takes great people across an entire company to build great tools. As a growing start-up, every employee has an opportunity to make a huge impact on our business, as well as ample opportunities to learn and grow. 									<div class="html"><p><strong>Full stack Software Engineer</strong> -£ Competitive - LOCATION / REMOTE&nbsp; Essential skills: PHP/Symfony/React/MongoDB&nbsp;</p><p>Benefits:</p><p>• Private health insurance</p><p>• Cash plan</p><p>• 25 days holiday (with ability to buy/sell an additional 5 days p.a.) &amp; your Birthday off</p><p>• Enhanced Pension Contribution - 5%</p><p>• Apple MacBook Setup</p><p>• Hybrid OR Remote First Working, with the requirement to attend quarterly events at our offices in either Farnborough, Manchester or our Birmingham hubs, so you could be based pretty much anywhere in the UK/Europe.</p><p><strong>Opportunity</strong></p><p>The Senior Full Stack Software Engineer works in Agile teams to design, build and maintain platform enhancements using technology and framework such as Symfony and React. This role collaborates closely with other Developers, Designers, Testers, and Product Owners to ensure the successful deployment of effective product solutions that align with the company's commercial goals. The Senior Full Stack Software Engineer is expected to deliver consistently on task commitments within deadlines while ensuring the<span class="WbZuDe"> code developed is modular, clear, testable, and maintainable across both the backend and frontend components of the application. </span></p><p><strong><span class="WbZuDe">Role </span></strong></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">Key responsibilities: </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• You’ll optimise a set of modern high performance real-time cloud-native apps that enable airlines, fuel suppliers and airports optimise aviation fuel operations and accountability across the whole lifecycle </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• These apps are fully connected and updated in real-time with a set of proprietary mobile apps for both pilots and airport ground handlers, facilitating all stakeholders involved to use data to always make the best decisions • You’ll build dynamic and modular components and backend services integrated with the backend via RESTFUL APIs, microservices and complex integrations for messaging, or telemetry mapping amongst others </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• You’ll ship high quality code, fully tested (producing unit, functional and e2e tests) • You’ll play a key role in one of our multiple product teams together with our outstanding product, design and other engineers contributing across the full development cycle If you have the following experience then you may be the Full Stack Engineer we need: Technical </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Front End: JavaScript, React, Redux, JSX, HTML, CSS, BEM, PubNub, Webpack, a11y (We also have some legacy areas of the platform we need to migrate built with jQuery, Bootstrap, Ractive &amp; Mustache/Handlebars/Twig) • Backend: Symfony PHP • Testing: PHPUnit, Behat, Jest, React Testing Library </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Main Tools: JIRA, Slack, Agile/Scrum, Continuous Integration, Peer Review, Pair Programming, TDD, BDD Behaviours </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• A willingness to want to learn and improve and indeed to want to help others to improve. </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Leadership - You should be a natural leader. Others should naturally look to you as a lead and gravitate toward you. </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Standards and Processes - You should appreciate why we have standards and processes in place, you should embrace them and more importantly look to improve them. </span></p><p><strong><span class="WbZuDe">Company </span></strong></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">Bring Your Skills and Passion to Life at i6: i6 Group is the fastest-growing aviation fuel management technology provider - enabling smarter and greener operations for airlines, fuel service providers, and suppliers. We have developed the broadest, fully functioning cloud-based solution, next-generation management and mobile platform for aviation fuelling and business aviation and are expanding our operations from the UK across Europe, Asia, Canada, USA and Australia. We work with the world’s largest airlines including British Airways, Virgin Atlantic, JetBlue, Delta, Air Canada and Lufthansa and all the major fuel suppliers at many major airports. </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">The Six i’s That Make i6: • Improve - we’re open to new ideas and deliver an amazing customer experience </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Influence - we build strong relationships and make great decisions </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Impress - we work hard and smart to deliver great work on time </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Innovation - we share ideas, experiment and find new ways to solve challenges </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Intelligence - we continue to develop our skills, knowledge, and behaviours </span></p><p><span class="WbZuDe">• Integrity - we respect and embrace differences in people APPLY NOW</span></p>																																				Please mention the word <strong>ENVIOUS</strong> when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTU0LjE4MC4xNTkuMTM3). To string things together, we mix in just the right amount of documentation, with best practices such as focusing on the “why?” and keeping it simple.</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type:disc;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre-wrap;">Focus on what matters</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre-wrap;">: Our CI/CD pipeline uses quality tools such as Psalm, PHPStan, Rector, PHPCS, PHP CS Fixer, Deptrac, phpcpd, and ESLint to ensure consistency and code quality. This means we're almost bug-free despite having numerous, zero-downtime, fully automated deployments to production every day. We don't like bugs and would rather focus on what matters most.</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type:disc;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre-wrap;">Test Coverage</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre-wrap;">: “The only way to go fast, is to go well - Robert C. Martin”. We love automated testing, especially Unit Tests, and use TDD as much as we can. We've been increasing our test coverage over the years, reaching an overall 38% test coverage throughout the system, with critical systems having over 80% test coverage.</span></p></li></ul><h2 dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 4pt 0pt;"><span style="font-size:17pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre-wrap;">The Stack You Will Work On</span></h2><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:8pt 0pt 0pt 0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre-wrap;">#UseThePlatform. We’re working on a multi-year green-field project and are looking for an experienced software professional to play an important role in realizing our vision for Grow My Clinic. This is a significant opportunity to solve a key set of problems for our rapidly customer base and to further Jane’s mission of Helping the Helpers.\n\n\nLike with all positions at Jane, this position is a remote position, allowing you to work anywhere you want across Canada. Building a delighted team who can delight our customers is part of Jane’s DNA. In our most recent company-wide health check, 99% of our team agreed that our founders demonstrate people are important to Jane’s success. On top of that, 98% of our team felt Manager cares about them as human beings and that they are supported when needing to arrange time off from work. We’d never claim to be perfect, but we’re working hard to listen to our people and improve each day. \n\n\nWe really want the people who work at Jane to love being here, so it's important that we start with a bit about what makes our company unique and try to be as transparent as possible. Our&nbsp;values&nbsp;also provide some insights into Jane and hopefully, you’ll have a better idea if this might be the kind of company you want to be part of. \n\n\nBefore we were Jane, our Co-Founders were solving problems for their own clinics not realizing that a few years later, this team would grow to support tens of thousands of healthcare practices in more than 60 countries. Our platform is now helping to modernize the world of practice management software. We enable the likes of physiotherapists, mental health counsellors, chiropractors, and other allied health practitioners to run their practices in a digital-first way through features such as online booking, charting, scheduling, telehealth, and billing along with an evolving library of features. You can see more of them&nbsp;here. Although we’ve grown, still to this day, we’re rooted in solving clinics’ problems and making sure we don’t lose sight of Jane’s vision. \n\n\nWe have remained profitable for the past seven years, we’re product-led and growing organically (and responsibly) to the point where 85% of our customer growth is either from customer referrals or word of mouth. Growth like this is unique, especially in the world of SaaS, and it doesn’t happen by chance. We have a brilliant team of over 400 Janers who are doing an amazing job of listening to our customers, building what they need, and providing industry-leading support. We pride ourselves on flexibility &amp; autonomy, some of our team block out their calendars to pick up their children from school (and this is normal at Jane), and we even have a #kids channel in Slack.  \n\n\nWe’re not a clock-in clock-out system-type environment. With that being said, we’re not going to paint the picture of a perfect environment either. We’re a company that’s scaling quickly, we have many moving parts, many of us are doing this for the first time and sometimes, we don’t have processes in place or clear views which can require a lot of resourcefulness and a passion for problem-solving. \n\n\nWith all that to say, if you’re looking for an environment where you can grow, stretch yourself, and work with some incredibly talented people on problems that are positively impacting people's lives, Jane could be the place for you.\n\n\nCompensation Expectations for the Role\n\n\nJane’s committed to paying our team members fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $117,100 and a maximum annual salary of $182,900. As you may have noticed, this salary range is quite large, and this is intentional to account for the growth someone will experience in the role throughout their time at Jane (i.e., from building the skills, to accomplished, to highly proficient, all the way to achieving excellence in the role).&nbsp;When hiring talented folks to join the Jane team, we’ve found that new team members are best set up for success when hired with the expectation of being fully accomplished in the role, which for this role would reflect a salary between $139,000 to $146,300.&nbsp;It's also possible to join Jane at a salary above or below this, which would mean a salary below $139,000 which typically reflects someone who has all the potential to be fully accomplished in the role but doesn't yet possess all the skills required, while a salary above $146,300 is typically for individuals who are currently in this role at Jane and had the opportunity to make a significant positive impact on our customers, product and company with deep Jane knowledge.\n\n\nAt Jane, we pay for growth, which means that you’ll continue to have conversations about your career development with your manager and see your compensation grow over time as you build an amazing career with us.\n\n\nMore information on Jane's benefits package can be found&nbsp;here.\n\n\n\nThe impact you could have… \n* Your role will have significant responsibilities for contributing to the technical vision for the Grow My Clinic product, helping us move quickly, fail fast, and set the stage for significant scale in the future.\n* You will have the opportunity to participate in key decisions on infrastructure, data model, services, and interface, and be a force multiplier on what we can achieve going forward.\n* You will have the opportunity to build on your leadership and mentoring skills, working with your fellow developers to grow their skills and confidence.\n* You will use your experience in building quality software quickly to help us show one another what is possible when we combine effort and ability.\n* You will help us make a material impact on our customers’ ability to deliver their services to more patients, and subsequently help those patients improve the quality of their lives.\n* By helping us be true to our value for building delightful products, you will help us create advocates in the market and fuel the growth we can achieve.\n\n\n\nThe experience we feel we need:\n* Someone who can independently take charge of a specific component within our product, making swift and decisive progress. While collaboration remains a key part of our culture, we need someone who is confident in their ability to own and deliver a crucial piece of our application.\n\n\n* Lead the development and maintenance of critical components within the Grow My Clinic product, covering both backend and frontend aspects.\n* Utilize your expertise in technologies such as Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, and AWS to build robust, scalable solutions.\n* Act as a technical mentor, guiding less experienced developers and fostering a collaborative team environment.\n\n\n* Extensive full-stack development experience, with a strong grasp of infrastructure, backend, and frontend technologies.\n* Competency in containerization and orchestration tools, with exposure to platforms like Kubernetes or Amazon Elastic Container Service.\n\n\n* Significant experience in at least one of the following areas: designing and integrating APIs, developing modern, responsive web application interfaces, handling sensitive data (PHI and PII) with a focus on security and compliance, implementing DevOps practices, including CI/CD, and building reliable, observable systems, leading 0 to 1 software product development initiatives. \n\n\n* Proactive and capable Senior Developer who can bring their wealth of experience to our team, helping to drive the Grow My Clinic product forward efficiently and effectively.\n\n\n\n\n\nAt Jane, we’re committed to fostering an environment that allows you to come to work as your truest self. 									<div class="markdown">\nCoinbase Developer Platform and the Dev Portal is the destination for building and integrating web3 solutions, services, and products. We partner with other Coinbase products such as Base, Wallets-as-a-service, Staking, CB Pay, Advanced Trading, Commerce, Exchange so web3 developers can start building their onchain apps in minutes.\n\nThis role is for Coinbase Commerce, a powerful payment processing platform that enables merchants to securely accept crypto payments. With its user-friendly interface and seamless integration capabilities, Coinbase Commerce simplifies the process of incorporating digital currencies into online businesses using Shopify, WooCommerce or other platforms like Farcaster to expand their reach to a global customer base.\n\nWhat you'll be doing:&nbsp;\n\n\n* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable, secure, and high-performance fullstack systems for Coinbase Commerce using Ruby, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Solidity\n\n* Drive the technical vision and strategy for Coinbase Commerce, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices\n\n* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and prioritize features, improvements, and integrations that drive the growth and success of Coinbase Commerce\n\n* Develop and optimize smart contracts using Solidity for EVM-compatible blockchains to enable seamless crypto payment processing\n\n* Design and implement highly interactive, responsive, and user-friendly frontend interfaces using modern frameworks like React or Angular\n\n* Optimize frontend and backend performance, ensuring fast transaction processing, smooth UI interactions, and efficient resource utilization\n\n* Architect and implement secure, reliable, and well-documented APIs for Coinbase Commerce\n\n* Troubleshoot and debug complex fullstack issues, ensuring platform stability, reliability, and security\n\n* Drive the adoption of best practices in software development, testing, and deployment, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our engineering processes\n\n* Provide technical guidance and support to other engineering teams, and contribute to the overall technical direction of Coinbase\n\n\n\n\nWhat we look for in you:&nbsp;\n\n\n* 8+ years of experience in software development with a strong focus on fullstack development\n\n* Mastery of Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Solidity; familiarity with Ruby is a plus\n\n* Deep understanding of Ethereum and EVM-compatible chains and experience with developing smart contracts\n\n* Proven track record of designing, developing, and shipping high-quality, scalable fullstack systems for payment processing platforms\n\n* Strong expertise in frontend development using modern frameworks like React or Angular, and experience with state management libraries like Redux or NgRx\n\n* Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and event-driven architectures\n\n* Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), caching systems (Redis, Memcached), and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ)\n\n* Comprehensive knowledge of RESTful API design principles and experience with API development, integration and authentication protocols like OAuth and JWT\n\n* Familiarity with AWS and expertise in containerization like Kubernetes\n\n* Deep understanding of web security best practices and experience with implementing secure coding practices for financial systems\n\n* Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to find elegant solutions to complex challenges in the crypto payment processing domain\n\n* Outstanding communication, leadership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to inspire and mentor teams\n\n* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience\n\n* Passion for Onhain/Web3 and a deep understanding of the crypto ecosystem and its potential applications\n\n\n\n\nJob #: GDFS06NA																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElasticCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. All of our compute runs through CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to our Kubernetes clusters. Our backend primarily serves a well-documented <a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" class="postings-link" href="https://developer.close.com/">public API</a> that our front-end JavaScript app consumes.
