									<div class="markdown">\nWe are looking for an Intermediate Developer at Jane to join our growing team. As Jane continues to scale, we need someone who is passionate about taking on complex projects and eager to develop their skills. This role is essential for helping us support and nurture our expanding team, providing a great opportunity to make a significant impact and grow with us.\n\n\nLike with all positions at Jane, this position is a remote position, allowing you to work anywhere you want across Canada. Building a delighted team who can delight our customers is part of Jane’s DNA. In our most recent company-wide health check, 99% of our team agreed that our founders demonstrate people are important to Jane’s success. On top of that, 98% of our team felt Manager cares about them as human beings and that they are supported when needing to arrange time off from work. We’d never claim to be perfect, but we’re working hard to listen to our people and improve each day. We really want the people who work at Jane to love being here, so it's important that we start with a bit about what makes our company unique and try to be as transparent as possible. Our&nbsp;values&nbsp;also provide some insights into Jane and hopefully, you’ll have a better idea if this might be the kind of company you want to be part of. \n\n\nBefore we were Jane, our Co-Founders were solving problems for their own clinics not realizing that a few years later, this team would grow to support tens of thousands of healthcare practices in more than 60 countries. Our platform is now helping to modernize the world of practice management software. We enable the likes of physiotherapists, mental health counsellors, chiropractors, and other allied health practitioners to run their practices in a digital-first way through features such as online booking, charting, scheduling, telehealth, and billing along with an evolving library of features. You can see more of them&nbsp;here. Although we’ve grown, still to this day, we’re rooted in solving clinics’ problems and making sure we don’t lose sight of Jane’s vision. \n\n\nWe have remained profitable for the past seven years, we’re product-led and growing organically (and responsibly) to the point where 85% of our customer growth is either from customer referrals or word of mouth. Growth like this is unique, especially in the world of SaaS, and it doesn’t happen by chance. We have a brilliant team of over 400 Janers who are doing an amazing job of listening to our customers, building what they need, and providing industry-leading support. We pride ourselves on flexibility &amp; autonomy, some of our team block out their calendars to pick up their children from school (and this is normal at Jane), and we even have a #kids channel in Slack.  \n\n\nWe’re not a clock-in clock-out system-type environment. With that being said, we’re not going to paint the picture of a perfect environment either. We’re a company that’s scaling quickly, we have many moving parts, many of us are doing this for the first time and sometimes, we don’t have processes in place or clear views which can require a lot of resourcefulness and a passion for problem-solving. \n\n\nWith all that to say, if you’re looking for an environment where you can grow, stretch yourself, and work with some incredibly talented people on problems that are positively impacting people's lives, Jane could be the place for you.\n\n\nCompensation Expectations for the Role\n\n\nJane’s committed to paying our team members fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $90,000 and a maximum annual salary of $135,000. As you may have noticed, this salary range is quite large, and this is intentional to account for the growth someone will experience in the role throughout their time at Jane (i.e., from building the skills, to accomplished, to highly proficient, all the way to achieving excellence in the role).&nbsp;When hiring talented folks to join the Jane team, we’ve found that new team members are best set up for success when hired with the expectation of being fully accomplished in the role, which for this role would reflect a salary between $106,900 to $112,500.&nbsp;It's also possible to join Jane at a salary above or below this, which would mean a salary below $106,900 which typically reflects someone who has all the potential to be fully accomplished in the role but doesn't yet possess all the skills required, while a salary above $112,500 is typically for individuals who are currently in this role at Jane and had the opportunity to make a significant positive impact on our customers, product and company with deep Jane knowledge.\n\n\nAt Jane, we pay for growth, which means that you’ll continue to have conversations about your career development with your manager and see your compensation grow over time as you build an amazing career with us.\n\n\nMore information on Jane's benefits package can be found&nbsp;here.\n\n\n\nThe impact you could have… \n* Enhance the developer experience by ensuring our solutions are user-friendly and efficient for fellow developers.\n* Work closely with senior developers to refine and implement solutions, contributing to a collaborative and innovative work environment.\n* Deliver high-quality, secure, and reliable code, especially in frontend platform development and accessibility, supporting our commitment to customer satisfaction.\n* Participate in project planning and execution, improving CI/CD pipelines and developer tools to ensure timely and effective delivery.\n* Develop deep technical knowledge in areas like frontend platform architecture or design systems, becoming a key contributor to our team's technical excellence.\n\n\n\nThe experience we feel we need:\n* You are proficient in TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks, particularly React.\n* You have experience with design systems and their implementation.\n* You are familiar with frontend build tools and module bundlers, such as webpack.\n* You have knowledge of accessibility (a11y) best practices and experience integrating them into projects.\n* You have experience with CI/CD pipeline development and enhancements.\n* You are familiar with developer tooling and improving the developer experience (DevX).\n* You understand security and reliability standards in frontend development.\n* You have a growth mindset, eager to learn and grow, continually seeking to improve your skills and stay updated with industry trends.\n* You have a collaborative spirit, working closely with team members and fostering a supportive and cohesive team environment.\n* You are DevX-oriented, committed to enhancing the developer experience and ensuring solutions are user-friendly and efficient.\n* You are a proactive problem solver, taking initiative to identify and solve issues, driving positive changes and innovations.\n* You have attention to detail, delivering high-quality, clean code that meets security and reliability standards.\n* You are adaptable, flexible in handling changing requirements and priorities in a fast-paced environment.\n* You are an effective communicator, clearly articulating ideas, providing constructive feedback, and documenting work comprehensively.\n\n\n\n\n\nAt Jane, we’re committed to fostering an environment that allows you to come to work as your truest self. 										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nRole: Junior Software Test Specialist\n\n\nTell me about Igloo!\nOne of our core beliefs at Igloo is that people are a company’s biggest asset. This philosophy is woven into everything we do at Igloo – our behaviors, our culture, and especially our digital workplace solutions, which we use internally every day. You might say we talk the talk and walk the walk!\n&nbsp;\nIgloo’s goal is to help people communicate and collaborate in the workplace. This means creating simple but effective workflows to enable people to create content and a delightful experience for consuming and collaborating on it.\n&nbsp;\nAnd that’s why we can offer you a superior employee experience that goes beyond superficial perks and promises and gives you the true sense of purpose you’ve been waiting for.\n\n\nWhy this role is important:\n As a Junior Software Test Specialist, you are passionate about software testing and quality. In this role you will work closely with the quality and release team to detect regressions in existing features and thoroughly test new features to ensure quality throughout the application as it continues to grow and change.\n&nbsp;\nThe primary functions of the role will be writing and executing test cases for new features, writing detailed bug reports and reproduction steps, maintaining existing test cases as previously released features change, verifying bug fixes, and ensuring previously logged and unresolved defects are still valid and require remediation. 											<span style="font-weight: 400;">Jane Software is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Intermediate Software Developer Clinical Group</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nWe're looking for Intermediate Software Developers at various levels to join Jane's Clinical Group. This group of teams is responsible for allowing practitioners to focus on providing the best patient care. This group owns features in our app like charting, intake forms, clinical surveys, integrations, and more. We’re also building for a new type of Jane user - the 3rd party developer. Providing extensibility opportunities in our charting domain is a new, multi-year initiative that you’ll get to play a role in shaping. Most of our roles are full-stack though we allow that developers may tend more to front-end or back-end focus.\n\n\nLike with all positions at Jane, this position is a remote position, allowing you to work anywhere you want across Canada. Building a delighted team who can delight our customers is part of Jane’s DNA. In our most recent company-wide health check, 99% of our team agreed that our founders demonstrate people are important to Jane’s success. On top of that, 98% of our team felt Manager cares about them as human beings and that they are supported when needing to arrange time off from work. We’d never claim to be perfect, but we’re working hard to listen to our people and improve each day.\n\n\nWe really want the people who work at Jane to love being here, so it's important that we start with a bit about what makes our company unique and try to be as transparent as possible. Our&nbsp;values&nbsp;also provide some insights into Jane and hopefully, you’ll have a better idea if this might be the kind of company you want to be part of.\n\n\nBefore we were Jane, our Co-Founders were solving problems for their own clinics not realizing that a few years later, this team would grow to support tens of thousands of healthcare practices in more than 60 countries. Our platform is now helping to modernize the world of practice management software. We enable the likes of physiotherapists, mental health counsellors, chiropractors, and other allied health practitioners to run their practices in a digital-first way through features such as online booking, charting, scheduling, telehealth, and billing along with an evolving library of features. You can see more of them&nbsp;here. Although we’ve grown, still to this day, we’re rooted in solving clinics’ problems and making sure we don’t lose sight of Jane’s vision.\n\n\nWe have remained profitable for the past seven years, we’re product-led and growing organically (and responsibly) to the point where 85% of our customer growth is either from customer referrals or word of mouth. Growth like this is unique, especially in the world of SaaS, and it doesn’t happen by chance. We have a brilliant team of over 400 Janers who are doing an amazing job of listening to our customers, building what they need, and providing industry-leading support. We pride ourselves on flexibility &amp; autonomy, some of our team block out their calendars to pick up their children from school (and this is normal at Jane), and we even have a #kids channel in Slack.\n\n\nWe’re not a clock-in clock-out system-type environment. With that being said, we’re not going to paint the picture of a perfect environment either. We’re a company that’s scaling quickly, we have many moving parts, many of us are doing this for the first time and sometimes, we don’t have processes in place or clear views which can require a lot of resourcefulness and a passion for problem-solving.\n\n\nWith all that to say, if you’re looking for an environment where you can grow, stretch yourself, and work with some incredibly talented people on problems that are positively impacting people's lives, Jane could be the place for you.\n\n\nCompensation Expectations for the Role\n\n\nJane’s committed to paying our team members fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $90,000 and a maximum annual salary of $135,000. As you may have noticed, this salary range is quite large, and this is intentional to account for the growth someone will experience in the role throughout their time at Jane (i.e., from building the skills, to accomplished, to highly proficient, all the way to achieving excellence in the role).&nbsp;When hiring talented folks to join the Jane team, we’ve found that new team members are best set up for success when hired with the expectation of being fully accomplished in the role, which for this role would reflect a salary between $106,900 to $112,500.&nbsp;It's also possible to join Jane at a salary above or below this, which would mean a salary below $106,900 which typically reflects someone who has all the potential to be fully accomplished in the role but doesn't yet possess all the skills required, while a salary above $112,500 is typically for individuals who are currently in this role at Jane and had the opportunity to make a significant positive impact on our customers, product and company with deep Jane knowledge.\n\n\nAt Jane, we pay for growth, which means that you’ll continue to have conversations about your career development with your manager and see your compensation grow over time as you build an amazing career with us.\n\n\n\nThe impact you could have… \n* Collaborate closely with your team, technical leaders and cross-functional groups to ship impactful features that directly benefit our customers.\n* With more seniority, take on a leadership role by helping to drive projects, set goals and mentor fellow developers to foster growth and excellence within the team.\n\n\n\nThe experience we feel we need:\n* Recent Ruby on Rails experience as well as TypeScript and React. Consideration will also be given to specialized experience covering just the front-end or back-end of our stack.\n* Experience with systems design and dealing with technical complexities on solutions or projects.\n* Experience applying API design principles.\n* Experience in agile environments or with incremental delivery of value to customers.\n* Experience in up levelling a team from a engineering or operational excellence point of view.\n* Experience developing software in regulated industries like healthcare or payments.\n\n\n\n\n																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n
																											No salary data published by company so we estimated salary based on similar jobs related to Developer, Design, Typescript, Ruby and API jobs that are similar:\n\n
																																								 $70,000 — $115,000/year\n

											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Senior Software Developer Clinical Group</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nWe're looking for Senior Software Developers at various levels to join Jane's Clinical Group. This group of teams is responsible for allowing practitioners to focus on providing the best patient care. This group owns features in our app like charting, intake forms, clinical surveys, integrations, and more. We’re also building for a new type of Jane user - the 3rd party developer. Providing extensibility opportunities in our charting domain is a new, multi-year initiative that you’ll get to play a role in shaping. Most of our roles are full-stack though we allow that developers may tend more to front-end or back-end focus.\n\n\nLike with all positions at Jane, this position is a remote position, allowing you to work anywhere you want across Canada. Building a delighted team who can delight our customers is part of Jane’s DNA. In our most recent company-wide health check, 99% of our team agreed that our founders demonstrate people are important to Jane’s success. On top of that, 98% of our team felt Manager cares about them as human beings and that they are supported when needing to arrange time off from work. We’d never claim to be perfect, but we’re working hard to listen to our people and improve each day.\n\n\nWe really want the people who work at Jane to love being here, so it's important that we start with a bit about what makes our company unique and try to be as transparent as possible. Our&nbsp;values&nbsp;also provide some insights into Jane and hopefully, you’ll have a better idea if this might be the kind of company you want to be part of.\n\n\nBefore we were Jane, our Co-Founders were solving problems for their own clinics not realizing that a few years later, this team would grow to support tens of thousands of healthcare practices in more than 60 countries. Our platform is now helping to modernize the world of practice management software. We enable the likes of physiotherapists, mental health counsellors, chiropractors, and other allied health practitioners to run their practices in a digital-first way through features such as online booking, charting, scheduling, telehealth, and billing along with an evolving library of features. You can see more of them&nbsp;here. Although we’ve grown, still to this day, we’re rooted in solving clinics’ problems and making sure we don’t lose sight of Jane’s vision.\n\n\nWe have remained profitable for the past seven years, we’re product-led and growing organically (and responsibly) to the point where 85% of our customer growth is either from customer referrals or word of mouth. Growth like this is unique, especially in the world of SaaS, and it doesn’t happen by chance. We have a brilliant team of over 400 Janers who are doing an amazing job of listening to our customers, building what they need, and providing industry-leading support. We pride ourselves on flexibility &amp; autonomy, some of our team block out their calendars to pick up their children from school (and this is normal at Jane), and we even have a #kids channel in Slack.\n\n\nWe’re not a clock-in clock-out system-type environment. With that being said, we’re not going to paint the picture of a perfect environment either. We’re a company that’s scaling quickly, we have many moving parts, many of us are doing this for the first time and sometimes, we don’t have processes in place or clear views which can require a lot of resourcefulness and a passion for problem-solving.\n\n\nWith all that to say, if you’re looking for an environment where you can grow, stretch yourself, and work with some incredibly talented people on problems that are positively impacting people's lives, Jane could be the place for you.\n\n\nCompensation Expectations for the Role\n\n\nJane’s committed to paying our team members fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $117,100 and a maximum annual salary of $182,900. As you may have noticed, this salary range is quite large, and this is intentional to account for the growth someone will experience in the role throughout their time at Jane (i.e., from building the skills, to accomplished, to highly proficient, all the way to achieving excellence in the role).&nbsp;When hiring talented folks to join the Jane team, we’ve found that new team members are best set up for success when hired with the expectation of being fully accomplished in the role, which for this role would reflect a salary between $139,000 to $146,300.&nbsp;It's also possible to join Jane at a salary above or below this, which would mean a salary below $139,000 which typically reflects someone who has all the potential to be fully accomplished in the role but doesn't yet possess all the skills required, while a salary above $146,300 is typically for individuals who are currently in this role at Jane and had the opportunity to make a significant positive impact on our customers, product and company with deep Jane knowledge.\n\n\nAt Jane, we pay for growth, which means that you’ll continue to have conversations about your career development with your manager and see your compensation grow over time as you build an amazing career with us.\n\n\n\nThe impact you could have… \n* Collaborate closely with your team, technical leaders and cross-functional groups to ship impactful features that directly benefit our customers.\n* With more seniority, take on a leadership role by helping to drive projects, set goals and mentor fellow developers to foster growth and excellence within the team.\n\n\n\nThe experience we feel we need:\n* Recent Ruby on Rails experience as well as TypeScript and React. Consideration will also be given to specialized experience covering just the front-end or back-end of our stack.\n* Experience with systems design and dealing with technical complexities on solutions or projects.\n* Experience applying API design principles.\n* Experience in agile environments or with incremental delivery of value to customers.\n* Experience in up levelling a team from an engineering or operational excellence point of view.\n* Experience developing software in regulated industries like healthcare or payments.\n\n\n\n\n\nAt Jane, we’re committed to fostering an environment that allows you to come to work as your truest self. We believe it’s important to actively recognize, embrace, and celebrate our differences in order to make Jane an inclusive, equitable, and diverse workplace. \n\n\nWe want to build a team of people who make conversations rich with perspective and experience. We are committed to listening to every voice in order to learn and grow because doing this will allow us to meet the needs of the diverse community of helpers that Jane serves. \n\n\nWe do not tolerate discrimination, prejudice, or oppressive isms of any kind. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, experience, and the needs of the Jane community. We encourage anyone who requires accommodation or adjustments throughout the interview process to let us know, and we will do our best to support you.																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

The primary responsibilities include providing support for our various people committees, overseeing programs such as DEIB and Social initiatives, coordinating Learning and Development efforts, contributing to Talent Acquisition endeavors, ensuring Health and Safety compliance, providing P&amp;C administrative and office support, and engaging in pertinent projects as needed. roll out content required for Coconut employee training and coordinate third party learning vendors and consultants when required\n\n* Promote a learning culture by creating and communicating L&amp;D opportunities across the organization\n\n* Support leaders and P&amp;C Business Partner team with employee development needs by sourcing training programs/materials and making recommendations.\n\n* Act as the administrator for Coconuts LMS (WorkRamp)\n\n* Ensure all employees complete required compliance training by tracking and following up with employees and leaders\n\n* Provide ongoing updates to the company onboarding program, ensuring we are providing current, up to date information\n\n* Support Talent Acquisition with full cycle recruitment efforts to ensure appropriate staffing levels – posting, reviewing candidates, interviewing, employment offers and working with recruitment agencies as needed\n\n* Lead Coconut employee programs including the DEIB committee, Social committee and the Health and Wellness committee.&nbsp; Support the planning and execution of events for these programs, and budget allocation\n\n* Provide support in the Toronto office by managing passcards and lock system (activations/deactivations), ensuring we are compliant with H&amp;S requirements and assist in any coordination with facilities needs\n\n* Coordinate employer branding opportunities through social posts; creating the copy for marketing approval\n\n* Coordinate Birthday, Cocoversary &amp; Life Event perks administration&nbsp;\n\n* Support P&amp;C Manager in All Hands preparation\n\n* Support other P&amp;C related projects and initiatives in conjunction with the P&amp;C Business Partner team\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM\n\n\n* Minimum 2 years human resources experience\n\n* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in HR, Business or related field\n\n* Excellent verbal and written communication skills\n\n* Proficient understanding of employment legislation\n\n* Analytical critical thinker &amp; problem solver, with the ability to see and empathize with competing perspectives to create and deliver ideal solutions\n\n* Resourceful mindset with the ability to understand when to research autonomously and when to ideate collaboratively\n\n* Self-starter with an unparalleled attention to detail\n\n* Relationship builder who can operate cohesively and effectively with many roles cross-organizationally\n\n* Strong project management skills\n\n* Agile mentality with the ability to shift focus in alignment with business needs\n\n\n\n																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

											<span style="font-weight: 400;">Igloo Software is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Account Management Executive</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nTitle:  Account Management Executive&nbsp;\n&nbsp;\nTell me about Igloo!&nbsp;\nOne of our core beliefs at Igloo is that people are a company’s biggest asset. This philosophy is woven into everything we do at Igloo – our behaviors, our culture, and especially our digital workplace solutions (which we use every day). And that’s why we can offer you a superior employee experience that goes beyond superficial perks and promises, and gives you the true sense of purpose you’ve been waiting for.&nbsp;\n&nbsp;\nIgloo’s goal is to help people communicate and collaborate in the workplace. This means creating simple but effective workflows to enable people to create content and a delightful experience for consuming and collaborating on it.  We need a design leader who fights for the user, sets a high bar for design in all of our products and is a champion for instilling a design culture in our business.&nbsp;\n\n\nWhy this role is important:&nbsp;\nAs an Account Management Executive, will be responsible for growing an existing book of business through consultative selling. You’re a master at owning the sales cycle from beginning to end, identifying key stakeholders and driving solutions to complex business problems. &nbsp;\n&nbsp;\nYou will develop, execute and manage the sales strategy and successfully close deals, owning the sales cycle, driving solutions that solve complex challenges for our customers.  Working in an environment where our largest competitor is no longer viable and where the market has opened, you understand the value of sales to an organization. &nbsp;\n\n\n\nThe impact you'll have:\n* Sales Execution: qualify customer leads to maximize revenue and focus sales energy on winnable customer growth, accurately forecast quarterly revenue to meet and exceed targets&nbsp;\n* Close Execution: manage entire sales cycle process, engage resources as required, perform customer presentations, coordinating product demos, business cases, and ROIs&nbsp;\n* Customer Sales &amp; Relationship Management:grow existing customer revenue and communicate product value proposition and solution design in collaboration with customer success team to drive product solution growth.&nbsp;\n* Revenue Generation: effectively articular Igloo’s unique value proposition and tailor offerings to solve business pains and our customer business challenges&nbsp;\n* Lead Sale Campaigns: proactive approach to managing business and technical relationships for Igloo’s customers to increase customer growth&nbsp;\n\n\n\nIdeal persona:\n* Accountability – a proven closer, you approach your goals with a total ownership mindset&nbsp;\n* Resourcefulness – solution-focused, you leverage your internal MacGyver and overcome obstacles and turns things into a win&nbsp;\n* Confidence to lead – you possess the knowledge and experience to lead any sales conversation and inspire those around you&nbsp;\n* Hunter &amp; Farmer - you have a strong “hunter” mindset, but you also have the ability and skill to build, nurture and maintain strong relationships with customers&nbsp;\n* Catalyst for growth– if there is something you know, about a product, a process, or an industry, you are not afraid to pass knowledge on to team members&nbsp;\n* Focus on continuous improvement – you learn from every lost deal you’ve ever had and never repeated the same mistake twice&nbsp;\n\n\n\nThe keys to success:\n* 6+years' experience selling SaaS products, preferably within social, communication, and collaboration platforms&nbsp;\n* 2+ years’ experience in account management&nbsp;\n* Proven track record of exceeding sales targets, vertical quotas as well as measuring customer growth&nbsp;\n* Previous experience migrating customers to a new product and/or selling a new suite of products&nbsp;\n* Experience running the sales cycle within a small and nimble team&nbsp;\n* Strong solution-focused and relationship building skills – past success working with customers to build business cases and ROI development&nbsp;\n* Excellent account management skills and ability to manage external and internal business priorities&nbsp;\n* Demonstrable experience building influential relationships with C-level and Director level executives.&nbsp;\n* Ability to assess customer challenges, perform qualification, clearly articulate the benefits of our digital workplace solution, and ask for the business.&nbsp;\n* Focus on continuous improvement – you learn from every lost deal you’ve ever had and never repeated the same mistake twice&nbsp;\n* Proven ability to effectively collaborate with cross functional teams&nbsp;\n* Commitment and ability to travel up 25% of your time&nbsp;\n* Experience using CRM system such as Salesforce.com.&nbsp;\n\n\n\n\n\nWhat we have to offer:\nWe offer a training budget for every employee, health benefits and a wellness spending account, and support a 100% remote work environment. You choose whether you work on a Mac or PC, whatever hardware makes your work easier.\n\n\nIf you’re looking for a role with the right mix of autonomy and team collaboration, an environment that fosters transparency and trust, a company with seasoned leadership and backed by a leading investment firm, a career with lots of opportunity and room for growth, and a chance to personally influence how organizations work, then we invite you to step inside Igloo.\n\n\n\n\nSound like you? Apply now!\n\n\nIgloo is committed to building and supporting a culture of diversity, inclusion, and accessibility. We hire the best talent regardless of race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, veteran status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression.\n\n\nIgloo welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.\n\n\nLearn more about Igloo Software:&nbsp;https://www.igloosoftware.com/careers/																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

																			<div style="text-align:left;font-size:32px;">
											<span style="font-weight: 400;">BrowserStack Software Private Limited is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Software Development Engineer Test</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">Who are we and what do we do? BrowserStack is the world's leading software testing platform powering over two million tests every day across 19 global data centers. BrowserStack's products help developers build bug-free software for the 5 billion internet users accessing websites and mobile applications through millions of combinations of digital environments—devices, browsers, operating systems, and versions. We help Tesco, Shell, NVIDIA, Discovery, Wells Fargo, and over 50,000 customers deliver quality software at speed by moving testing to our Cloud. With BrowserStack, Dev and QA teams can move fast while delivering an amazing experience for every customer. BrowserStack was founded by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal in 2011 with the vision of becoming the testing infrastructure for the internet. We recently secured $200 million in Series B funding at a $4 billion valuation in June 2021. At BrowserStack we solve real problems—each day is a unique challenge and an opportunity to make a difference. We strive to be open, transparent, and collaborative, so no feat is too big to achieve. BrowserStack is an extension of its people and a place where they can grow both professionally and personally. To that effect, we’re humbled to be recognized by leading organizations around the world: BrowserStack is Great Place to Work-Certified™ 2020-21 Named “SaaS Startup of the Year” in 2022 by SaaSBOOMi Ranked in Forbes Cloud 100 in 2021 - for the second time Featured in LinkedIn Top Startups India 2018 Role in nutshell: The role holds the candidate responsible for task execution for quality engineering and should be able build and execute test cases. The ideal candidate must possess strong automation skills with programming and a person with metrics oriented mindset. Desired experience: 1- 3 years of experience writing automated tests using automation frameworks and tools, such as Selenium, Appium and Qtest is preferred. Ability to learn NodeJS and Ruby quickly Knowledge of general QA procedures and methodologies, as well as software development fundamentals Comfortable working in a fast-paced, constantly changing atmosphere Bachelor's degree in a technical field preferred What will you do? Create, maintain, and execute test specifications and test cases Perform integrity and regression testing using a combination of manual and automated techniques Writing and executing automated tests for new features Follow, Identify and implement best practices/opportunities to improve the QA process Work with Engineering and Product teams to identify high-impact issues Benefits: In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy: Medical insurance for self, spouse, upto 2 dependent children and Parents or Parents-in-law up to INR 5,00,000 Gratuity as per payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 Unlimited Time Off to ensure our people invest in their wellbeing, to rest and rejuvenate, spend quality time with family and friends Remote-First work environment that allows our people to work from anywhere in India Remote-First Benefit for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience At BrowserStack we’re building the testing infrastructure for the world. We’re extremely curious, passionate, and customer-obsessed about our mission of empowering developers to build amazing experiences. We know we’ll grow only when our people grow—so we build teams that are open, transparent, collaborative, and above all supportive. We’re remote-first and our people have the choice to work from anywhere—it’s our core values that bring us all together and drive everything we do. We’re thinkers, movers, innovators, and doers who believe no feat is too big to achieve. We strive to deliver awesome results, fast; and in that way, we’re a lot like you.																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Senior Product Engineer</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="html"><div class="framer-1amxjan"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">We are building the support platform for developer tools. Think Linear meets Stripe for support: A pro tool that’s delightful to use right out of the box, and powerful to build with.</p><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Support might seem boring at first, but we think it’s one of the most interesting products to work on. Support tools are the very definition of a productivity tool. They’re inherently multiplayer, high volume and collaborative with unique technical demands. Plus, every company that has customers, has customer support - a huge software market.</p><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer to help us lead and shape all things backend at Plain. You'll be joining an intentionally small, commercially savvy, and product-centric team. Everyone on our team is technical, commits code, and speaks to customers. We maintain complete internal transparency on almost everything, and are just as driven by building a great product as we are by building a great company.</p></div><div class="framer-141syf7"><div class="framer-zlxwki"><h3 class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-nz8k4z">What you'll do</h3></div><div class="framer-13f4ytm"><ul class="framer-text"><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><strong class="framer-text">Shape our architecture.</strong> You'll work on some of our most complex technical challenges and help others do the same. You'll help decide how we build things and what we prioritise as a product and engineering team.<br></p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><strong class="framer-text">Guide product direction:</strong> We believe that all engineering decisions are product decisions, and vice versa. You'll collaborate with everyone on the team to decide what we work on and why, and help build Plain to be the best product and business it can be.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><strong class="framer-text">Help build a small team with outsized impact:</strong> We want to build an intentionally small company because we believe that small teams are more efficient than big teams. You'll play an integral role in shaping our product, culture and ways of working to enable this.</p></li><li><strong class="framer-text">Create a stellar developer experience.</strong> You'll help make sure the experience of building with Plain second to none. You'll play a key role in everything from how we structure our data model through to designing our APIs and writing documentation.<br></li></ul></div></div><div class="framer-msch0h"><div class="framer-pt3o4u"><h3 class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-nz8k4z">This is a great fit if you…</h3></div><div class="framer-1ojpeud"><ul class="framer-text"><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Enjoy being hands-on with a focus on writing code and shipping things. There is a lot to build.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Want to work day-to-day in a&nbsp;<a rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1wicq5s" href="https://journal.plain.com/posts/2022-02-08-a-magical-aws-serverless-developer-experience/">full-stack Typescript and serverless codebase</a>.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Want to work as part of a small, multi-disciplinary team and collaborate closely with others.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Want to work on something (nearly) greenfield. The biggest product and company decisions still lie ahead of us.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Enjoy the autonomy, uncertainty and unpredictability that comes with an early stage company.</p></li></ul></div></div><div class="framer-7haxt3"><div class="framer-3gd8vt"><h3 class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-nz8k4z">This won't be the right role if you…</h3></div><div class="framer-9oj8xu"><ul class="framer-text"><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Want to manage a team. Given our team growth plans, this is unlikely to be a need in the next 12-24 months.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Mainly want to deepen your expertise in a particular technology or domain. This role is best for product and business focused engineers.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Want all of the benefits that come with an established tech company - top-end comp, free drinks and lunches, etc.</p></li><li class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-21ogod">Want a traditional product team set up, with a predictable roadmap, clearly scoped out tickets, a PM, and so forth.</p></li></ul></div></div>																																				Please mention the word <strong>COMMODIOUS</strong> when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTU0LjE4MC4xNTkuMTM3). 											<span style="font-weight: 400;">Jane Software is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Senior Software Developer Payroll &amp; Compensation</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nWe're looking for an experienced full-stack senior developer to join the Payroll &amp; Compensation team. The Payroll &amp; Compensation team is a brand new mission critical team that will enable payrolls and streamline compensation for our customers. You will be a key player in establishing and shaping this team that directly contributes to Jane’s mission and big rocks. This is a leadership position where you will not only be solving critical customer problems but also set technical direction for the team.&nbsp;\n\n\nLike with all positions at Jane, this position is a remote position, allowing you to work anywhere you want across Canada. Building a delighted team who can delight our customers is part of Jane’s DNA. In our most recent company-wide health check, 99% of our team agreed that our founders demonstrate people are important to Jane’s success. On top of that, 98% of our team felt Manager cares about them as human beings and that they are supported when needing to arrange time off from work. We’d never claim to be perfect, but we’re working hard to listen to our people and improve each day.\n\n\nWe really want the people who work at Jane to love being here, so it's important that we start with a bit about what makes our company unique and try to be as transparent as possible. Our&nbsp;values&nbsp;also provide some insights into Jane and hopefully, you’ll have a better idea if this might be the kind of company you want to be part of.\n\n\nBefore we were Jane, our Co-Founders were solving problems for their own clinics not realizing that a few years later, this team would grow to support tens of thousands of healthcare practices in more than 60 countries. Our platform is now helping to modernize the world of practice management software. We enable the likes of physiotherapists, mental health counsellors, chiropractors, and other allied health practitioners to run their practices in a digital-first way through features such as online booking, charting, scheduling, telehealth, and billing along with an evolving library of features. You can see more of them&nbsp;\nhere. Although we’ve grown, still to this day, we’re rooted in solving clinics’ problems and making sure we don’t lose sight of Jane’s vision.\n\n\nWe have remained profitable for the past seven years, we’re product-led and growing organically (and responsibly) to the point where 85% of our customer growth is either from customer referrals or word of mouth. Growth like this is unique, especially in the world of SaaS, and it doesn’t happen by chance. We have a brilliant team of over 400 Janers who are doing an amazing job of listening to our customers, building what they need, and providing industry-leading support. We pride ourselves on flexibility &amp; autonomy, some of our team block out their calendars to pick up their children from school (and this is normal at Jane), and we even have a #kids channel in Slack. \n\n\nWe’re not a clock-in clock-out system-type environment. With that being said, we’re not going to paint the picture of a perfect environment either. We’re a company that’s scaling quickly, we have many moving parts, many of us are doing this for the first time and sometimes, we don’t have processes in place or clear views which can require a lot of resourcefulness and a passion for problem-solving.\n\n\nWith all that to say, if you’re looking for an environment where you can grow, stretch yourself, and work with some incredibly talented people on problems that are positively impacting people's lives, Jane could be the place for you.\n\n\nCompensation Expectations for the Role\n&nbsp;\nJane’s committed to paying our team members fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $117,100 and a maximum annual salary of $182,900. As you may have noticed, this salary range is quite large, and this is intentional to account for the growth someone will experience in the role throughout their time at Jane (i.e., from building the skills, to accomplished, to highly proficient, all the way to achieving excellence in the role).&nbsp;When hiring talented folks to join the Jane team, we’ve found that new team members are best set up for success when hired with the expectation of being fully accomplished in the role, which for this role would reflect a salary between $139,000 to $146,300.&nbsp;It's also possible to join Jane at a salary above or below this, which would mean a salary below $139,000 which typically reflects someone who has all the potential to be fully accomplished in the role but doesn't yet possess all the skills required, while a salary above&nbsp;$146,300&nbsp;is typically for individuals who are currently in this role at Jane and had the opportunity to make a significant positive impact on our customers, product and company with deep Jane knowledge. At Jane, we pay for growth, which means that you’ll continue to have conversations about your career development with your manager and see your compensation grow over time as you build an amazing career with us.\n&nbsp;\nMore information on Jane's benefits package can be found&nbsp;here&nbsp;\n\n\nLearn more about Jane's approach to compensation&nbsp;here\n\n\n\nThe impact you could have...\n* Own and contribute to the technical direction that will shape the trajectory of the Payroll &amp; Compensation Team\n* Coach and mentor others on the team \n* Collaborate with engineers, technical leaders and cross-functional groups to ship impactful features that directly 	impacts our customers and company metrics\n* Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes\n* Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for early-stage product to iteratively evolve and scale, and taming complexity and shoring up reliability of existing systems\n* Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation\n* Contribute to the codebase as a hands-on engineer\n\n\n\nThe experience we feel we need…\n* Extensive experience in building scalable platforms\n* Strong understanding of development best practices, modern technologies, and design patterns and apply them to the development lifecycle for your team to improve the team’s codebase\n* Comfortable in Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Python or Go, navigating codebases with different languages and tools\n* 5-8 years of experience shipping high quality products \n* Ability to work well cross-functionally and earn trust from co-workers at all levels\n* Experience mentoring and growing senior engineers as their technical leader\n* Have experience in ensuring great user experience and ease of use of features and products you build\n* Have experience with financial product companies and interest in financial products and markets (nice to have)\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nAt Jane, we’re committed to fostering an environment that allows you to come to work as your truest self. We believe it’s important to actively recognize, embrace, and celebrate our differences in order to make Jane an inclusive, equitable, and diverse workplace. \n\n\nWe want to build a team of people who make conversations rich with perspective and experience. We are committed to listening to every voice in order to learn and grow because doing this will allow us to meet the needs of the diverse community of helpers that Jane serves. \n\n\nWe do not tolerate discrimination, prejudice, or oppressive isms of any kind. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, experience, and the needs of the Jane community. We encourage anyone who requires accommodation or adjustments throughout the interview process to let us know, and we will do our best to support you.																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n

																			<div style="text-align:left;font-size:32px;">
											<span style="font-weight: 400;">Coconut Software is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Senior Customer Success Manager</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nOur Enterprise Customer Success Managers work closely with some of our largest and most strategic customers at Coconut Software. They partner closely with our customers to understand their organization functions, how they have set up and leveraged Coconut, and help them get the most out of their Coconut investment. Our Enterprise CSMs build deep relationships with our customers, often acting as an extension of their internal teams.\n\nThis role is for you if you are someone that:\n\n\n* Deeply likes to understand how things work. Our enterprise customers often have unique set ups and integrations and our Enterprise CSMs understand the ins and outs of how they have set up Coconut.\n\n* Consultative mindset with a love for data. You know how to ask the right questions, connect the dots, and have been described as a trusted advisor. You also&nbsp; don’t shy away from data but rather you know when, where, and how to use data to tell a story or recommend an action to both your customers and colleagues.\n\n* Takes ownership in complex situations. Whether it be identifying new opportunities for Coconut to grow the customer or managing escalations, you thrive on solving problems and bring in the right resources and team to help you execute on your plan.\n\n* Cultivates relationships.&nbsp;You’re comfortable building relationships across different teams both internally and externally and understands the importance of being multi-threaded at organizations.\n\n\n\n\nCore metrics of this role include retention, customer satisfaction, product adoption, and supporting expansion. While reporting directly to the SVP, Customer Experience, you are seen as a mentor to the rest of the Customer Success team and a go to person to help the team grow and develop.\n\nYOU'RE FIRED UP TO\n\n\n* Oversee large and complex customer accounts. Proactively engage customers throughout their Coconut journey from go-live to renewal to growth. Ensuring you thoroughly understand their set up and use of Coconut and advise them on additional functionalities, features, and integrations to deepen their outcome with Coconut&nbsp;\n\n* Deepen relationships with our key contacts while identifying other key stakeholders at our customer’s organization&nbsp;\n\n* Collaborate closely with the Enterprise Pod consisting of Account Executives, Account Managers, Solution Engineers, and Implementation Managers to deliver ROI to customers, drive advocacy amongst the customer organization, and tee them up for ongoing success and growth with Coconut Software&nbsp;\n\n* Work closely with the Enterprise Sales team to identify and maximize new opportunities across the named Enterprise accounts\n\n* Leverage both qualitative and quantitative data points to provide recommendations to your customer to help them get the most out of Coconut as well as inform Coconut Leadership on the customer’s health\n\n* Create meaningful and personal moments for our customers and turn them into raving advocates of Coconut&nbsp;\n\n* Identify successful plays and best practices for our enterprise customers and help refine existing internal processes for the Enterprise team&nbsp;\n\n* Demonstrate Coconut Software’s values and project a positive, upbeat, and professional tone in all communications, both internal and external\n\n* Travel to customer sites and between Coconut’s offices as needed\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM\n\n\n* 5+ years of B2B customer-facing SaaS experience working with customer organizations that have over 50,000 employees\n\n* Experience navigating complex companies with different business units and buying needs&nbsp;\n\n* Thrive on understanding our customers inside and out - you are equally comfortable working with an individual contributor as you are with executives at our customers’ companies\n\n* Love helping others succeed, both our customers and your colleagues&nbsp;\n\n* Exceptional communication skills whether over email, phone call, video call, or in-person&nbsp;\n\n* Creative thinker and problem solver who loves to tell stories\n\n* An entrepreneurial spirit. The CSM, alongside the overall pod, partners closely with both prospects and customers and deep dives into their workflows and needs, often charting a path that hasn’t been crossed before.&nbsp;\n\n* You are as comfortable using data to make informed decisions as you are reading between the lines of a customer conversation when forecasting health\n\n* Thrive in ambiguous environment with little or changing processes&nbsp;\n\n* Comfortable using SFDC, Excel, Catalyst.io, Asana, and Jira&nbsp;\n\n* Bonus points for experience working at/with financial institutions or fintech\n\n\n\n\n																																																										\n\n#Salary and compensation\n
																											No salary data published by company so we estimated salary based on similar jobs related to Developer, SaaS, Senior and Sales jobs that are similar:\n\n
																																								 $60,000 — $112,500/year\n
																								<br>
													\n\n#Benefits\n
													💰 401(k)\n\n🌎 Distributed team\n\n⏰ Async\n\n🤓 Vision insurance\n\n🦷 Dental insurance\n\n🚑 Medical insurance\n\n🏖 Unlimited vacation\n\n🏖 Paid time off\n\n📆 4 day workweek\n\n💰 401k matching\n\n🏔 Company retreats\n\n🏬 Coworking budget\n\n📚 Learning budget\n\n💪 Free gym membership\n\n🧘 Mental wellness budget\n\n🖥 Home office budget\n\n🥧 Pay in crypto\n\n🥸 Pseudonymous\n\n💰 Profit sharing\n\n💰 Equity compensation\n\n⬜️ No whiteboard interview\n\n👀 No monitoring system\n\n🚫 No politics at work\n\n🎅 We hire old (and young)\n\n<br>

sales process\n\n* Uncover and document key requirements from all key stakeholders in the Customer’s organization\n\n* Conduct in-depth product demos with your prospects and provide solutions based on their requirements\n\n* Carry out contract negotiations, ensuring that all terms of our engagement with larger customers are clear\n\n* Manage multiple sales cycles from initial conversations to activation\n\n* Leverage other lead opportunities when time permits to support your pipeline\n\n* Drive process improvements to better connect with our customers\n\n* Achieve and surpass quota requirements for each fiscal year\n\n* Provide feedback to contribute to product development and sales/marketing campaigns designed to improve the customer experience as well as grow Coconut’s ARR in 									<div class="html"><p dir="ltr">We are looking for a tenacious, passionate, creative, software-driven individual to guide the design and development of our payments software.&nbsp;<strong>This role is remote only in Australia, Spain, United Kingdom, Brazil and Poland. Please note we pay by regional labor market rates, so the posted salary range may or may not apply to your particular region. Feel free to inquire at your first interview invitation about your specific salary range.</strong></p><h3 dir="ltr">OBJECTIVE #1 Take on a project and see it to its end.</h3><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Potential Obstacles: &nbsp;We work by 6 week cycles (similar to sprints) where it can be easy to lose focus or forget to plan ahead to ensure the successful completion of your projects.&nbsp;</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Actions: &nbsp;Understand the value of a successful cycle completion and use your tenacity to carry each project to the very end.&nbsp;</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Results: Your project completion numbers are stellar and you have concentration available for the handful of projects on your plate.&nbsp;</p></li></ul><h3 dir="ltr">OBJECTIVE #2 Work as a synchronous team in a remote environment.</h3><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Potential Obstacles: Working remote has many personal and team-based challenges from timezone differences, to communication and trust of your colleagues.&nbsp;</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Actions:&nbsp;Develop deep working relationships with your colleagues to know what they’re working on, and how to support each other.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Results:&nbsp;The team culture is strong, Rebilly’s bigger projects efficiently move forward.</p></li></ul><h3 dir="ltr">OBJECTIVE #3 Help your colleagues raise their skills with thoughtful code reviews and feedback on ideas.&nbsp;</h3><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Potential Obstacles: Your day will be filled with your own projects and priorities, and offering feedback to a remote team from afar can be intimidating.&nbsp;</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Actions: Prioritize your schedule and share your unique knowledge and experience to help make your team stronger.&nbsp;</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Results: Your team is more precise, creative, and their knowledge is deepened with your help.&nbsp;</p></li></ul><h3 dir="ltr">KEY FUNCTIONAL AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY&nbsp;</h3><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">What will you manage?&nbsp;</p></li></ul><p dir="ltr">Each teammate receives a role within a small team per cycle that can include a handful of small projects, one large project, or staying outside of the cycle to support clients, bugs, and cycle planning. Along with that, you’ll be responsible for ensuring adherence to programming and documentation policies, code standards, testing, release, and reporting updates on your projects.</p><div><br></div><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">What will you contribute to?&nbsp;</p></li></ul><p dir="ltr">You will contribute to code reviews, generating projects for each cycle, feedback for ideas (including the ideas for other areas of the company), and hiring new teammates in the Product Team.</p><div><br></div><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">What will you support? &nbsp;</p></li></ul><p dir="ltr">Outside of generally supporting your teammates in the Product Circle, Rebilly is an open environment where everyone is welcome in every area of the company. Our flagship product is an all-in-one business solution that helps inspectors conduct and share inspections, manage and automate their operations, and market their business<strong></strong></p><p dir="ltr">We’re proud to say Spectora is the market leader in the home inspection space, an achievement possible because of our fanatical focus on our customers, product, and team. We go head-to-head with bigger competitors with deeper pockets every day and are winning.<strong></strong></p><p dir="ltr">And we win because of our people.</p><p dir="ltr">Our culture is driven by our scrappy, hilarious, and relationship-focused team, who bring IQ and EQ to the table. We push ourselves and each other to grow in our careers and as people and are focused on being the best versions of ourselves every day. Spectora is a genuinely exceptional place to work (if we do say so ourselves).<strong></strong></p><p dir="ltr">Want to hear about our culture directly from the team? ⏭ https://youtu.be/ticzqdTGAlo</p><h2 dir="ltr">About the Position</h2><p dir="ltr">We're seeking a talented UX Engineer who is passionate about crafting seamless user experiences and is excited to take ownership of our design system from an engineering perspective. In addition to working closely with engineering, you’ll be collaborating closely with our Growth Product Manager to drive product-led growth by optimizing and experimenting across the entire funnel.</p><h3 dir="ltr">Responsibilities</h3><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Assist the UX/UI team with filling gaps in the design system leveraging UX best practices (ex: errors or focus states).</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Work closely with the UX/UI design team to translate our design system from Figma into functional, scalable, and maintainable Vue components within Storybook.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Develop and maintain documentation for our design system, ensuring it is up-to-date and accessible to both designers and developers.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Own the engineering side of our design system, ensuring it meets our high standards for usability, accessibility, and performance across all platforms.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Work closely with our Growth Product Manager, focusing on rapid experimentation and optimization of the product funnel to drive user growth and engagement.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Collaborate on the design and execution of experiments, analyzing results, and iterating to optimize the experience.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Advocate for UX best practices and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the team.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Troubleshoot and resolve UI/UX issues, ensuring a high-quality user experience.</p></li></ul><h2 dir="ltr">Who You Are</h2><p dir="ltr"><em>We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every bullet point. We are people, not checklists, and we hire as such!</em><strong></strong></p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong><br></p><ul><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Proven experience in UX Engineering or Front-End Development, with a strong portfolio that includes work with design systems and evidence of impactful UX improvements.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Expertise in Vue.js or comparable component-based frameworks (React, Angular, etc.), with a willingness to learn Vue if not already proficient.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Experience with Typescript</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Experience with Storybook or similar.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Experience with Ruby on Rails is highly valued but not mandatory.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Experience with Figma and familiarity with implementing designs into code with precision.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Experience with A/B testing and web analytics tools, with a data-driven approach to design and optimization.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams to understand and meet their needs.</p></li><li dir="ltr"><p dir="ltr">Strong communication and collaboration skills, capable of working effectively with both technical and non-technical team members.<br></p></li></ul><h2 dir="ltr"><strong>Pay &amp; 											<span style="font-weight: 400;">PhotoCircle is hiring a </span><br>
											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Senior Software Engineer</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="html"><h2><strong>About PhotoCircle</strong></h2><p>PhotoCircle is a private photo and video sharing service used by millions of consumers and businesses. The app allows users to create private albums, called Circles, and selectively choose who can join. The app is available on iOS and Android, with web usage currently limited to business users. Consumer usage is primarily comprised of college students, travel, and social events in the US. The PhotoCircle for Business Platform, launched in 2022, targets industries selling physical goods and services – home construction, solar installation, fashion, travel tours, food &amp; beverage distribution, and more – allowing them the ability to manage their users and circles at scale. The app has 66k ratings, averaging 4.9 stars on the Apple App Store, and ranks in the top 50 of the Photo &amp; Video category. Users praise the app for its simple, consumer-focused design, allowing them to easily stay connected with the people they care about.</p><p><br></p><h2><strong>Restrictions</strong></h2><ul><li>No Agencies Please</li><li>No Recruiters</li><li>DO NOT email us, call us, or add us on LinkedIn</li></ul><p><br></p><h2><strong>The Job</strong></h2><p>You will be responsible for working on the backend services at PhotoCircle, which are used to power all applications and store customer data.</p><p>Our stack makes use of Python, PostgreSQL, HAProxy, Envoy, Nginx, gunicorn, gRPC, gevent, Redis, TimescaleDB, Grafana, and many other technologies and services, including services we’ve written ourselves.</p><p><br></p><h3>Responsibilities</h3><ul><li>Developing new APIs for our mobile and web applications</li><li>Maintaining existing services built on gRPC, gevent, and gunicorn</li><li>Debugging problems across our stack, including logs from various servers such as HAProxy and Nginx</li><li>Crunching data and feeding results to services used by our sales and marketing teams</li><li>Building APIs and services used by our enterprise customers</li></ul><h3><strong>Must-Have</strong></h3><ul><li>Exceptional ability and experience in Python development, including recent versions.</li><li>Experience working on customer-facing systems, where external users and customers are depending on reliability.</li><li>Strong knowledge of testing and QA practices for APIs and services. An ideal candidate will be familiar with mypy, tox, pytest, and similar Python testing systems.</li><li>Ability to work within Linux, including socket programming and an understanding of common tools like top, df, grep, du, iostat, netstat.</li><li>Strong understanding of software engineering and computer science principles, especially for the creation of efficient and maintainable data structures, and the design of highly concurrent programs.</li><li>Fluent written English communication skills</li></ul><h3><strong>Should-Have</strong></h3><ul><li>Experience with PostgreSQL, including an understanding of its different indexes, internal statistics tracking, and transaction IDs.</li><li>Experience working with AWS systems and resources.</li></ul><h3><strong>Nice-to-Have</strong></h3><ul><li>Experience with gRPC</li><li>Basic web programming experience</li><li>DevOps experience - Ansible, GitHub Actions, Continuous Integration</li><li>Understanding of SOC 2 compliance</li></ul><p><br></p><h2><strong>Our Process</strong></h2><p>We are a small, experienced, distributed team that operates asynchronously over Slack, Notion, and Figma. We do not do calls or Zoom meetings. You can work your own hours from anywhere as long as the work gets done. We are highly agile, frequently shipping code to production.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p>																																				Please mention the word <strong>SENSATIONS</strong> when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTU0LjE4MC4xNTkuMTM3). This is a feature to avoid fake spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and instantly see they're human.<br>

View the benefits guide on the CS&amp;S website for details. Note that benefits for employees outside the US vary, and non-US employment is limited to countries supported by Remote.com\n\nLocation: Remote, in a time zone with at least 3 hours of overlap with PST (host is in Seattle)\n\nReports to: Dylan Baker, Research Engineer\nAbout The DAIR Institute\n\nThe Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR) aims to work on interdisciplinary AI research with ethics and foresight baked in from the start. Our center is distributed to ensure that researchers from many different backgrounds can participate while embedded in their communities. We aim to communicate our work in forms that are accessible and useful to members of impacted communities, rather than purely based on research papers accessible only to a select few.You can learn more about DAIR at https://dair-institute.org.\nPosition Summary\n\nIn this internship, you will contribute to DAIR’s goal of communicating our research to the public through creative means. Over the course of this internship, you will work with Dylan and other members of the DAIR team to construct a creative piece designed to reach an impacted community who might benefit from, and might not otherwise have access to, DAIR’s work.\n\nAt least one output of this project should be a zine (examples: coveillance, A People’s Guide to Tech, zines about labor organizing), with both a print and digital form. However, this does not have to be limiting. Depending on your interests and the topic we select, this project can include additional outputs, such as: creating posters, organizing a workshop, building an interactive web page, tabling at a zine fest, or creating some other artistic intervention heretofore unseen. The underlying goal is simply to communicate DAIR’s work to relevant communities, and this project will include some amount of creative flexibility.\n\nYou will be expected to attend weekly team meetings and regular check-ins with your host.\nDesired Qualifications\n\n\n* Proactive communication skills; confidence asking questions and seeking help when needed\n\n* Strong writing skills (some experience in scientific/technical communication or educational writing helpful)\n\n* Interest in grassroots movement organizing, especially around tech\n\n* Familiarity with the tech industry/AI ecosystem and understanding the social implications of artificial intelligence (not strictly necessary, but helpful)\n\n\n\n\nCandidates should have at least one of the following:&nbsp;\n\n\n* Experience with some form of graphic design and/or illustration\n\n* Experience creating zines through any medium (be it low-fi DIY copy machine cut-and-paste or a meticulously-designed mini art book)\n\n* Basic understanding of web design and development tools (HTML/CSS/JavaScript)\n\n* Experience in some kind of artistic medium that lends itself to this work (e.g. traditional illustration, mixed media art, web design, print design) Note: we are not interested in “AI-assisted” art practices of any form.\n\n\n\nWork Location &amp; Environment\n\nThe DAIR Institute is fully remote and geographically distributed, but we require this position to be at a location with a timezone that has at least 3 hours of overlap with the Pacific and Eastern time zones in order to work closely with your host.\nApplication Information\n\nTo apply, please submit your CV/resume and a portfolio of your work by March 6, 2024.\nEqual Opportunity Employer\n\nThe DAIR Institute is fiscally sponsored by Code for Science &amp; Society (CS&amp;S). 											<h1 style="font-size:32px;">Remote Partner Support Specialist</h1>
										</div>
									
									<div class="markdown">\nThe GWC Curriculum &amp; Instruction Team is searching for a highly organized, detail-oriented and reliable Partner Support Specialist to support our corporate Partner communications, onboarding, data collection, and in-program support for our 2024 Summer Programs, which you can learn more about here.\n\n\nThis position reports to the Manager, Partner Training and Support on the Curriculum &amp; Instruction team, and is focused on providing high touch, high quality support to corporate Partner organizations and points of contact who support, plan events, and sponsor our Summer Immersion Program (SIP) and Self-Paced Program (SPP).\n\n\nThis is a part time (up to 20 hours per week), remote, temporary position through September 13, 2024 with the possibility to extend the contract. Successful applicants will bring at least two years of experience with operations, customer service or a customer facing role.\n\n\nThe hourly rate is $20 - $25.\n\n\nResponsibilities:\nPartner Communications (30-35% of your time)\n-Monitor the GWC Partner email inbox, including answering questions, escalating requests, and communicating programmatic reminders with high touch professional courtesy.\n-Support the Manager, Partner Training and Support in creating communications content and staging in our email marketing platform, Campaign Monitor or Yesware.\n\n\n\n\nPartner Onboarding, Training and Support (50-55% of your time)\n-Track and monitor Partner onboarding and logistical information collected via surveys and follow-up with Partners to gather missing information or complete onboarding steps as needed.\n-Ensure that Partner data is accurate, reportable, clear, and easily accessible using our customer relationship platform, Salesforce.\n-Support with the logistics of organizing virtual Partner trainings and roundtables. This may include tracking training registrations, setting up Zoom calls, creating attendance trackers, etc.&nbsp;\n-Support the Manager, Partner Training and Support in QAing and maintaining documentation related to Partner Onboarding, Training and Support.&nbsp;\n-Help QA Partner Training and Onboarding materials as needed.&nbsp;\n-Support Partners with updating event details and maintaining their calendar for their Classroom on HQ, GWC’s custom curriculum platform.&nbsp;\n-Support with the review and QA of SIP Classroom calendars leading up to the launch of the program.&nbsp;\n\n\n\n\nSummer Programs Student &amp; Teacher Communications (10-15% of your time)\n-Help manage our ticket escalation system during the program, including answering questions, requests, and communicating programmatic reminders with high touch professional courtesy.\n-Proactively contact Teaching Teams and other Summer Programs staff around programmatic and logistical items related to Partner Support to ensure a positive experience for our Programmatic Stakeholders. This may include things like supporting the collection of classroom photos, quotes and other content to help craft Partner impact reports.&nbsp;\n\n\n\n\n\nQualifications:\n* Have 2+ years of experience with operations, customer service or customer facing roles;&nbsp;\n* Have excellent people skills with an ability to balance priorities, negotiate, and work with a variety of internal and external Partners. You are able to approach difficult situations with Partners, Staff, and/or Students with calm, poise, and a solutions-oriented approach before and during the program.\n* Have strong written and verbal communication skills and be able to craft and deliver audience-appropriate prose for Partners volunteers, Teachers, and Students as needed.&nbsp;\n* Have strong organizational and project management skills. You are detail-oriented, can keep track of timelines, clearly and proactively communicate with multiple stakeholders, and you are great at documentation.\n* Reliable internet connection and the ability to commit to a regular work schedule. There is some flexibility in working hours, but at least 3 hours per working day should overlap with Girls Who Codes core business hours of 8:00 AM-6:00 PM EST.&nbsp;\n* Be comfortable working independently and being a part of a remote, distributed team.\n* Have a demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new technology platforms and tools.\n* Be committed to our mission to close the gender gap in technology fields through a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.\n* PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:\n* Prior experience working with non-profits or start-ups\n* Experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, and customer service ticketing platforms.\n* Experience within academically and culturally diverse classroom communities.\n\n\n\n\n$20 - $25 an hour\n\nGirls Who Code is committed to building a truly diverse and inclusive organization with a focus on valuing, serving, and understanding our target constituents, while challenging all stakeholders to think inclusively for the betterment of our programs.\n\n\nGirls Who Code is an equal opportunity employer committed to a policy of equal treatment and opportunity in every aspect of its hiring and promotion process without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sexual orientation, partnership status, gender and/or gender identity or expression, marital, parental or familial status, national origin, ethnicity, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, age, disability, or any other legally protected basis.
